## Vote in the Tuesday, August 9th Primary Election
Friend, Tuesday is an important day Election Day for grassroots conservatives. The Political Establishment wants you to sit at home and stay out of this one. They'd prefer to keep real grassroots, conservative activists on the sideline so they can get their handpicked swamp creatures elected. But on Tuesday, August 9th YOU have the ability to send a message to the Political Establishment that you want a new course for our state! **That means:** **\- Passing the Never Again Bill** **\- Giving Back the Entire Surplus** **\- Protecting Health Freedoms** **\- Getting rid of unconstitutional, multi-subject omnibus bills** It's not every day you can make a big difference. But the winner of many legislative district primaries comes down to a couple hundred votes. YOU can be the difference maker! If you are fed up with the Political Establishment running our state and country into the ground, follow these instructions on Tuesday:
* Find your polling location. Click on this link: [**FIND POLLING PLACE**](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=ubk1FolAq6WRuAxNmhA93VJcs5l4BDTnm18Mfb6IJCl64TykgpW9Go6kyZmIAH4s&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=primary_email_3&n=2)
* Look up your sample ballot and make sure to only vote for candidates in one party. The Primary election works a little different than the general election where you can vote for anyone. In the primary, once you vote for a person of one party, you can only vote for the candidates of that party. A sample ballot is found at the same link as above.
* Learn how sitting legislators vote in St Paul. Did you know that all Senators have a failing grade on our scorecard? And in the Minnesota House, there's only a few who have scored an "A" grade. Visit [**MNSCORECARD.COM**](https://www.action4liberty.com/scorecard?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=primary_email_3&n=3)**** to learn more.

subject: Call me an American
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Hung Cao for Congress
body:
Democrats - including my opponent - have told me I’m “white adjacent” and “extremist” because I don’t meet the narra
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zch1v82un8i3700podvbopq7mtrr2tu1nn4ljo00_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbo62t346lqecpbke1or2pr469jmecplmlpn3c70edgrddbjmqrb1ob1muq6ctlgcv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6ptie1j38oljcjjr5cj662ob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933cdg60pj4s9h68oh5u)
| | | [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z67lo9qlb7su523j75p4buq44vdhdoprseqta32g_rp22sh2s8i66or0c1j69oj2chh2bs)
---
Fellow Patriot, Democrats - including my opponent - have told me I’m “white adjacent” and “extremist” because I don’t meet the narrative of an oppressed minority immigrant who craves unlimited handouts.

My family escaped communist Vietnam and came to America as legal refugees. My parents took every opportunity that was given to them to make a life for their family. My father even took a job that only allowed him to see us every six months.

It was hard, but my parents’ grit and determination inspired me to push myself to the limit and seek every opportunity this great country had for me. I attended the U.S. Naval Academy and served in the Navy as a Special Operations Officer.

My time in the Navy was incredible - but it was also challenging. I diffused bombs in places like Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia. I dove into treacherous waters to salvage the remains of fallen soldiers.

_But no matter where I went, I brought my most prized possession - my American flag - with me._

I looked to that flag for strength. It was a reminder of everything our great country had achieved, and everything we were going to in the future. But with Joe Biden abandoning our troops in Afghanistan and rolling out the red carpet for the Taliban, he put a stain on our flag that I could not take in vain.

Politics was never my dream or goal. Standing shoulder to shoulder with my brothers and sisters and arms and raising a family in the greatest nation on Earth was all I ever wanted. But just because I hung up my Naval uniform doesn’t mean I was done looking out for my fellow soldiers.

I knew that with the Commander in Chief abandoning them, I had to serve them in a new capacity: as a member of Congress.

Politics is a whole different beast. Instead of dismantling Improvised Explosive Devices (IEDs), I’m fighting off keyboard warriors who want to shame me for unapologetically loving our country.
But I have one request for my opponents who want to erase my heritage and divide our citizens by the color of their skin: instead of calling me “white adjacent” or “extremist” because I believe in the Constitution, all I ask is that you call me an American. Because I know I’ve earned it.

[**If you’re ready for a new generation of conservative leadership in Congress, I hope you’ll stand with me today and bring our country together under the greatest flag in the world.**](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9hoqhv4022tgp07jig2srevlmmm227k58osbc7o_rp22sh2s8i66or0c1j69oj2chh2bs)

---
In Liberty,
---

## America Is No Longer America
---
Yesterday, the **FBI** (_aka the unconstitutional three letter agency that has become the police force of the Democratic Party_) raided the home of **President Donald Trump** in Florida. I remember growing up there was a saying that kids tossed around when they would do or say something that someone disagreed with: **"This is a free country."** American children cannot make that statement today. The America that you and I were born into no longer exists and that is evident by the actions of the **FBI** and **Former Vice President Joe Biden** who have successfully turned this nation into a _Banna Republic_. Our nation is in serious trouble. **This is not a Trump issue. This is an American issue that impacts all of us.** I wish there was an easy solve to the problems we face of severe corruption, but I believe we have reached the point as a nation that **we need a miracle**. The good news is **the God of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob** , **the God of our Founding Fathers** is still a _miracle worker_. I believe we should take some time today and intentionally and fervently pray for our nation. Thank you,

## The Church Needs Strong Leaders Now More Than Ever

| Greater Georgia Newsletter August 9, 2022
It's official: we are just under 3 months out from the Tuesday, November 8th General Election in Georgia! For the last 18 months, Greater Georgia has been working day in and day out to register new, conservative voters across the state - and to grow the conservative movement by educating and mobilizing diverse communities, the disengaged, and the disenfranchised. Now that we are in the final stretch of the 2022 election cycle, we're kicking our efforts into high gear - but we'll need your help!

Asked why she, who'd suffered a bitter loss to Raphael Warnock in a runoff for the U.S. Senate seat she'd held since being appointed to the position by Georgia Gov. Brian Kemp, took it upon herself to take on the "lonely" task of organizing a grassroots campaign to register conservative voters in Georgia, Kelly Loeffler doesn't even need a moment to think about her answer.
"Because (the lack of such a campaign) happened to me," Loeffler, the businesswoman/turned Senator/turned organizer, said during a conversation with The Albany Herald. "I felt called to put on the hood of public service in Georgia, but sometimes God may have a different plan for how you serve."

name: Rep. Demings
subject: take this to heart straight from me, friend
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Val Demings for U
body:
I have a hot cup of coffee and few minutes to spare right now
| | |
---
Hi friend,

I'm not sure when my team will get this note to your inbox, but I have a few minutes to spare right now – so I wanted to talk to you about the final 91 days of this campaign, starting with a quick story from when I was a little girl.
My parents, James and Elouise, weren't rich. My father worked as a janitor. My mother was a maid. Neither finished high school. But they had such a profound sense of duty to make life _better_ for me and my six brothers and sisters. They grounded the importance of education and civic responsibility into us.

As a matter of fact, my parents took their civic responsibility so seriously that they were 100% faithful to voting. Every time. In one instance, when our station wagon wouldn't start, they paid someone to drive them to the polls.

**They were so committed to voting, friend, that as a little girl, I thought it was illegal _not_ to vote!**
My mind is on my parents in these final 91 days of the election. People just like James and Elouise Butler – people who count so much on our democracy – are already casting their ballots in Florida's primary. They'll likely be thinking of their families as they tick off a box, hoping the people they send to Washington will do right by them and _commit to bettering _the lives of those they serve.
I know this because as I travel across Florida and meet so many incredible people, I hear stories that remind me of my upbringing. I hear stories that inspire me every day to _win this race_ so we can do better for Floridians and all of America. **So take this to heart straight from me, friend: I am in this race to win, and when I make it to the U.S. Senate, we’ll be able to pass a bold legislative agenda.**
My time is up, and I need to get on with my day. Before I sign off though, I've got to ask: **With polling showing me neck and neck with Marco Rubio, can you chip in a grassroots donation of $5 or whatever you can spare to help me pull ahead, win and expand our Democratic Senate majority? Here's a link where you can make a contribution:[https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/vd_senate-fr-email](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48977555/360347793/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3985-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMjU2NmM2NS1lNzE3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cfIIa3OZK53wBJeiSVhRZ_DHOKa_45-Zo9RYjASGgtY=)**

Enjoy the rest of your day, friend – and thanks for everything you do for this grassroots campaign.

Val Demings

Anti-democracy extremists like Steve Bannon have bragged about getting “stormtroopers” to challenge votes at polling places. Conspiracy theorists are winning primaries across the country. clean_body: | Friend, As more extreme figures in our politics push ideas that threaten our democracy, one thing I regularly hear people ask is what we can do to stop it. Anti-democracy extremists like Steve Bannon have bragged about getting “stormtroopers” to challenge votes at polling places. Conspiracy theorists are winning primaries across the country. And election deniers have set their sights on state and local positions where they won’t have much competition—but they will have a lot of control over future elections. We need strong, pro-democracy candidates to run and win elections against the extremists who put party over country. While that isn’t something we do at the Republican Accountability Project, I wanted to take a moment to tell you about one group that is working to build out that pro-democracy bench of public servants. Country First Academy specializes in recruiting and training anyone who cares deeply about our democracy to run for office and volunteer for election administration positions. I’m really glad to see an organization like them stepping up, especially now. If you ever wanted to join the frontlines in fighting for your community and protecting our democracy, Country First Academy is leading that fight. Be sure to check them out and see if you want to join. Yet, criminals like Trump should be able to commit their crimes unmolested by the federal government, so long as they have the right politics. body:
As a diplomat in the Obama administration, Tom Malinowski stood up to dictators overseas. Now experts say his re-election could be THE deciding race for control of the House this year. If you’d like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.malinowskifornj.com/p/Bix_Do8Sr0m0vj5sQl0SCA2?unsubscribedata=SZMy92IrGGU3FM7FRx%2FMzCn%2FupIXCpfEoxn3w9N20Gl3TxHk550cEeaU%2B1%2FDHGP5hk9qK0D96r45YhpWoBjXwAOAre6F%2BTZutqki6h3PfHcKVHYRV8LEY%2B2w9CayZhPeXXkxdPcfTa8dmsxyIvPX0iuiYR5l9KxTHkcixsYScgZSWB2FwubrkHixUigOV5UjQlGa3WhcNgxjPmBpSoPpmicLkVCfC2952UiXHgKC1FRe23bl7S0ROpPqHyUdhLsZXsi1hiqKV7CjiiP%2F7foIfYEU4fDvqCeuj3n6GaUPdgzhmAsqhzpbBKRIhL%2BM0GOGm%2FYG3XOKcAuFaPFbcH7FnxFLhhrsRXQwBW2injzZI5Hheu6p3nPQsgmrVd63JHtIlxfApM5yKiQ939nBExeC7%2Bi8Q%2Fyd4jYEUyGTi8lWBTDDUCY3eBQrI0QE5pEgtUXs)
---
| |
---
Hi team,

With just three months left till Election Day, we are officially in the final sprint towards the midterms. Here on Team Malinowski, we’ve been thinking a lot about what this means for our community — on the one hand, the heavy responsibility we’re all carrying together, but also the power and privilege we have to be in a position to make such a major difference.

Team, the truth is that after many decades of partisan gerrymandering all around the country, there just aren’t all that many competitive districts left. In most places, because of the way the maps are drawn and the way voters are divided among districts, you can say with a fair amount of confidence whether a Democrat or a Republican is going to represent that district in Congress.

**[But not in NJ-07. Team, New Jersey’s 7th district is one of the last few truly competitive Congressional districts in the country — and the LAST competitive district in New Jersey. So what happens in Tom’s fight for reelection will likely determine who’s in control of Congress — and the fate of our BIGGEST issues, from our most fundamental freedoms to the future of our democracy.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48984940/360377927/1719613603?amount=10&refcode=TM_EM_FR_3MO_20220809_1_3&refcode2=f718ab20-f417-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzE4YWIyMC1mNDE3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cQW70W2TCYdHeEcZI0vLYZZo2e8M6tr36dvw5R61mXk=)**

**[Chip in now to stand with Tom and help hold this seat>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48984943/360377941/1719613603?amount=10&refcode=TM_EM_FR_3MO_20220809_1_3&refcode2=f718ab20-f417-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82MzYzOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmNzE4YWIyMC1mNDE3LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cQW70W2TCYdHeEcZI0vLYZZo2e8M6tr36dvw5R61mXk=)**

Team, we know it’s a lot of pressure for our small-but-mighty grassroots community. But it’s also a lot of power. Yes, we have to work incredibly hard. Yes, we have to spend a whole lot of money to compete with Tom’s Super PAC-funded opponent. **But with our votes, with the doors we knock on and the neighbors we talk to, and with the work we put in now, WE can decide who’s in power in the House of Representatives — paving the way to defend our democracy and help our country find the path forward.**

We have less than 100 days to give this our all, and our goal is to do _everything we possibly can_ to send Tom to victory again this year. What that looks like concretely is a MASSIVE voter contact operation — to make sure we’re talking to every undecided voter in the district — and then a voter turnout push bigger than anything our district has ever seen.

Peter —
Yesterday, the FBI raided Mar-a-Lago — Trump’s home in Florida.
And here’s what Ron DeSantis had to say about it:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-aug-2022?refcode=809trump [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-aug-2022?refcode=809trump]

DeSantis won’t condemn Nazis. He won’t condemn January 6th. But he has no problem attacking the FBI and undermining the rule of law to keep Trump happy.
That’s why we need to beat him, Peter. Floridians deserve a Governor who believes in the rule of law and upholds the American values of truth and justice. body:
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qstldk-ttjjilthht-r/) Hi Peter, **It's been a bad two weeks for Jared Polis, and it's about to get worse!** Two weeks ago, a [Denver Post piece](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qstldk-ttjjilthht-y/) surfaced about the indefensible behavior of the man he has running Colorado's Emergency Management Office, Mike Willis. Since then, Jared Polis has refused to answer any questions about how long he has known about this and why he has not held Willis accountable. And, just this past week, Polis spent nearly $3 million in taxpayers' money to send what he calls an "instructional letter" along with your TABOR refund check. In reality, it is a campaign flyer dropped in that attempts to take credit for what he has shamefully renamed the "Colorado Cash Back." [](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qstldk-ttjjilthht-j/) [**(click to play video)**](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qstldk-ttjjilthht-t/) Rest assured, as your governor, I will lead with transparency and accountability - something I will require of everyone who works in my administration. And now, as your candidate for governor, I am seeking to hold Polis accountable.I have called publicly on Polis to fire Mike Willis and explain to the people of Colorado how long he knew about this behavior. As for his election-year TABOR stunt, a campaign finance violation has been filed against him for using state dollars to campaign for his reelection. I have also called on him to repay the people of Colorado the $3 million he used for his campaign promotion. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qstldk-ttjjilthht-i/) Make no mistake, Polis is simply trying to run from his own failed record. We won't let him.Please check out our new website _[ThePolisTax.com](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qstldk-ttjjilthht-d/). _Each day, we explain one more way Jared Polis and his partner in crime, Joe Biden, are making it harder to live, work, and raise a family in this state.Polis is simply doubling down on Joe Biden's failed policies here in Colorado. Don't take my word for it. He's already pledged his support for all the damage Biden has caused. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qstldk-ttjjilthht-h/) [**(click to play video)**](https://heidi4gov.cmail19.com/t/i-l-qstldk-ttjjilthht-k/) There are just 92 days left until the election. While I believe that climate change is an important issue we need to responsibly address and manage, it doesn’t have to be at the expense of your bank account.

For instance, when the state of California makes ‘zero emissions’ goals, it’s incredibly expensive.

In fact, just recently, the Wall Street Journal posted an articlehttps://www.wsj.com/articles/how-the-climate-elite-spread-misery-heat-wave-global-warming-energy-adapted-temperatures-deaths-environment-11658437091?utm_medium=email&utm_source=mailchimp&utm_campaign=Are climate policies working?&utm_term=X(you can read it right here) (https://www.wsj.com/articles/how-the-climate-elite-spread-misery-heat-wave-global-warming-energy-adapted-temperatures-deaths-environment-11658437091?utm_medium=email&utm_source=mailchimp&utm_campaign=Are climate policies working?&utm_term=X) https://www.wsj.com/articles/how-the-climate-elite-spread-misery-heat-wave-global-warming-energy-adapted-temperatures-deaths-environment-11658437091?utm_medium=email&utm_source=mailchimp&utm_campaign=Are climate policies working?&utm_term=Xall about how the climate ‘elitists’ are spreading misery, not solutions to everyday families in America.

We saw this recently be proven in California where, in the name of protecting the ‘climate’, California is over-regulating the food supply chain and forcing a massive halt on much of our trucking industry.

This is ultimately driving up your grocery store prices.

But it doesn’t have to be this way.

It’s entirely possible to help the climate and working families at the same time.

There are responsible, reasonable solutions that work to protect the climate, and at the same time won’t cause you to pay the price every time you go to the store or the pump.

Again, if you have a moment, read this article from thehttps://www.wsj.com/articles/how-the-climate-elite-spread-misery-heat-wave-global-warming-energy-adapted-temperatures-deaths-environment-11658437091Wall Street Journal, (https://www.wsj.com/articles/how-the-climate-elite-spread-misery-heat-wave-global-warming-energy-adapted-temperatures-deaths-environment-11658437091?utm_medium=email&utm_source=mailchimp&utm_campaign=Are climate policies working?&utm_term=X) and see for yourself just how avoidable this cost-of-living mess could be.

It always comes back to bad policy put forth by Newsom’s failing elitist leadership.

He is ignoring you and your family’s most basic needs for survival in this state.

That’s why come November, we’re going to take back this state and put it back in the hands of the people.

Change is coming, and there is hope for California.

- Senator Brian Dahle

name: Brenda Siegel
subject: Don't forget to vote today!
body:
| |
---
Friend, Today is primary day. We’re on the verge of becoming the Democratic nominee for governor, but we need your vote to make sure it becomes a reality. **** Brenda wanted us to share this from her, “I have shared the last three months with many primary election candidates, not all of whom will make it. I have been reflecting on how hard it is to put yourself out there. So, please make a plan to vote and thank candidates for taking the leap for the future of the state. Win or lose, each person has an impact on Vermont.” **** Today is a big day in our quest to move Vermont forward. With your vote, we’ll be making history. Brenda will be the first single mom and first openly bi woman to be the Democratic nominee for Governor in Vermont’s history. And she will be one of several firsts that will be on the General election ballot in November. This is an important race. Use your voice. If you haven’t voted yet, get out to your polling place by 7 p.m. to vote. **** No matter who you vote for, it’s important to get out there and make your voice heard. If you need to find your polling place, [use this interactive map from the Vermont Secretary of State Website!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTCRzW4Itb6Jgdi0HlNw7plGszM-iItwmAJbj9I4E3M40JMUNKk5BM1FSZTnP1lqS13j7FyCQ290GS9tpSoMP2dBI9wojyaqt0a1hBpdXtqrmX67kV8LRvK72cEGNeB6QXQlbp8m3qqLPkA2UtsKDlC8b4Iu4y29NUxHKXhhc6WXkqrZ2J_mfiNpyJ4DZfJJifvf3MI4vxMuo1uRTDQ7NjqW3iOhSLV0G2oLvhcAKcnW7QfB4v-qPncUKWjEON0HpBD-6DSLPlIktHilSd6J9SCB9EpW0FY3u6TwJl44jQc9Z/3og/oL7PExE8QjK_C_g8uegOJQ/h0/j0v6hVn-OVH272Kp3JxWY_AwwSOzXOLBC0UDnjr-Ug4) Remember that if you have not registered yet, you can register at the polls. Remember that if you have a felony conviction, in Vermont you can still vote. Remember that if you are 17, but will be 18 by the general election, you CAN vote in the primary. Vermont makes it easy to vote and your vote is your voice. Please use it.
---
|
---
Tonight, Brenda will be speaking at the Primary Night Watch Party for the Vermont Democratic Party in Waterbury. We want you to come and join us! Please show out so we can celebrate making history together! [Sign up here!](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zFQNrKPu5CwuISL2Wyx0C0mWdHgM9YWlidkikk2V_Cs3Z6Bph7TZWSGYjMoGVpvpe2iMMix4jbYAVOBDcpddMnepgxWDIipo74yb5UoF3eztwr9bZVwVVPGlm1oiuILQ9F4nlakhB7ZhMGeBMXDi-vlLtqzCett1c18LtaUA-X-b5AcvnoUCLo3ZtzTa4pe2xLyx7JAAkJq99J6DPsVmj3UDnRp3kwAfiK3zUSFYoeiLFnX0zfhY129XBbAaUaCAkeUh0vJ3ODg68eoll-d9xTbR0NbJ6hoL5v0AahnASQDQ/3og/oL7PExE8QjK_C_g8uegOJQ/h1/eZhC_hk0K2TH6UMRaHGjPpZGSSaqbHiaT_YWkxEDaIc) Whatever you do, VOTE!

clean_body: | | Friend, Today is primary day. We’re on the verge of becoming the Democratic nominee for governor, but we need your vote to make sure it becomes a reality. ** Brenda wanted us to share this from her, “I have shared the last three months with many primary election candidates, not all of whom will make it. I have been reflecting on how hard it is to put yourself out there. So, please make a plan to vote and thank candidates for taking the leap for the future of the state. Win or lose, each person has an impact on Vermont.” Today is a big day in our quest to move Vermont forward. With your vote, we’ll be making history. Brenda will be the first single mom and first openly bi woman to be the Democratic nominee for Governor in Vermont’s history. And she will be one of several firsts that will be on the General election ballot in November. This is an important race. Use your voice. If you haven’t voted yet, get out to your polling place by 7 p.m. to vote. ** No matter who you vote for, it’s important to get out there and make your voice heard. If you need to find your polling place, Remember that if you have not registered yet, you can register at the polls. Remember that if you have a felony conviction, in Vermont you can still vote. Remember that if you are 17, but will be 18 by the general election, you CAN vote in the primary. Vermont makes it easy to vote and your vote is your voice. Please use it. | Tonight, Brenda will be speaking at the Primary Night Watch Party for the Vermont Democratic Party in Waterbury. We want you to come and join us! Please show out so we can celebrate making history together! Whatever you do, VOTE! | Thank you, Brenda Siegel If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | Copyright (C) 2022 Brenda for Vermont. Derek,

I know I say this a lot, but it's because I really mean it: Nothing brings me more pride and joy than serving as your representative.

And one of my favorite parts about serving PA-06 is hosting town halls – getting the chance to talk to constituents and hearing your concerns.

But I know not everyone has the opportunity to make it to my town halls, so I'm bringing one to you. I'm reaching out today to ask you to submit a question – whether it's about inflation, climate change, or another issue close to your heart – and I'll send an email later responses to a few questions submitted today.
**Hearing from you is so important to me, Derek, so, if you have a minute or two to spare, will you submit a question below?**

Friend, it's hard to believe that we're less than 100 days out from Election Day.
When I first made the decision to run for Senate, I knew this race would be one of the toughest I've ever faced. **And at its core, my campaign has always been about making the people I love proud. **
Growing up poor, Black and female in the 1960s South meant that I didn't have a whole lot – but I did have unconditional love. Sometimes I wonder who I would be and what I would be doing if I didn't have a family who was determined to make me shine at all costs.
Because the truth is, if my father hadn't taken an advance out on his paycheck to send me on a school trip to D.C., if my mother had never told me to "never tire of doing good," if I hadn't had the support system of my six older siblings, all of my success may not have been possible.
**So friend, this campaign started as part of my mission to never tire of doing good and as a way to make my loved ones proud – but now it's about more than that.**
**[Right now, the very soul of our nation is at risk, and this is likely to all come down to Florida. subject: James Judge wins Tampa Republican Primary Poll in Landslide with 77 percent of votes

body:
The Republican favorite in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary, James Judge, dominated his two primary opponents in an online poll... | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us16.campaign-archive.com/?e=00028e5542&u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=35aac67f1a)
---
[](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=5bc2b9e9ba&e=00028e5542)
[**James Judge wins Tampa Republican Primary Poll in Landslide with 77 percent of votes**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=4063c2a09e&e=00028e5542)
_The Republican favorite in Florida’s 14th Congressional District primary, James Judge, dominated his two primary opponents in an online poll conducted by the Tampa Bay Young Republicans last week._ TAMPA, Fla. – James Judge won [the Tampa Bay Young Republicans primary poll](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=1969bc986a&e=00028e5542) with nearly 77 percent of the votes cast, the Judge campaign said Monday. The poll was conducted among more than 400 members of the Tampa Bay Young Republicans, who are aged 18-40 and will likely vote in the Aug. 23 primary election.Judge raked in 76.79% of the vote, compared to a combined 23.22% between his two primary opponents who are also on the ballot. One of those opponents, [Jerry Torres, was recently found to be disqualified ](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=c76d33ac22&e=00028e5542)by a Tallahassee Judge, though his name will still appear on the ballots as they had already been printed.The poll also showed Republican State House Candidate for District 65, Jake Hoffman, winning his primary in a landslide. Hoffman earned 84.51% of the vote.In Florida State House District 65, Republican Danny Alvarez had a commanding lead over his primary opponent. He received 81.82 percent of the vote.“I am humbled and honored to see our hard work on the campaign trail paying off in polls like this. The Tampa Bay Young Republicans’ poll reflects the momentum we’ve gained headed into the primary election, and I am so very grateful to all of those volunteering and helping with my campaign,” said Judge. “I genuinely appreciate the strong showing of support among the Tampa Bay Young Republicans and all my future constituents in the district. I’d also like to thank the TBYR for conducting the poll.”Judge has long been described as the “frontrunner” in the primary election, and the TBYR poll confirms that descriptor.As Judge engages with the community, meets more voters, and obtains more endorsements, his campaign continues to pick up steam.Judge recently earned the recommendation of the Tampa Bay Times, and has been endorsed by legendary Republican strategist Roger Stone, Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ), retired Republican Congressman Ted Yoho, The Tampa Police Benevolent Association, Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard, Chris Chambers, a former Congressional candidate and community leader, and former SBA White House Deputy Chief Matt Becker, who previously ran for Congress against an incumbent Democrat in St. Petersburg.Judge also plans on announcing more high-profile endorsements later this week.**About James Judge:
** Judge, who publicly announced his run for Congress earlier this year, is the only Tampa Bay area native running in the race, having been born in Clearwater, Florida. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and served in the U.S. Coast Guard in Operation Iraqi Freedom. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the NRA, Veterans of Foreign Wars and the American Legion. The Judges are also active members at Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

[View this message in your browser](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zd51s1pl224e9to18ft0tlnjci57e8svjthp0n30_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkhhm0o316gqb3d7jkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbo62thge6pn9opkmhob4pbnmip63dj6muqb4cjn61i39d5kspgj3cjnm1jr1p5gsv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj664rj6o37m9o6cdj0mdgefc5lclp238h1e8he4933cdg60or0c3h68oh5u)
Liz Cheney signed a multi-year deal with Team Pelosi |
Fellow Patriot,

In my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

So why is _Republican_ Liz Cheney playing on Nancy Pelosi's team?

Not only did she vote to impeach President Trump, praise Dr. Fauci, and slander Americans like you as a "danger" to our Democracy . . .

She's taken a leading role on Pelosi's Soviet-Style January 6th Commission!

[**This kind of betrayal cannot continue, which is why I hope you'll support my America First Primary Challenge against Liz Cheney with a $35 or more campaign contribution?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgns59mgfa1u1ddb2p2lrbh7d03akqvv1asg59jg_rp22sh2s8i66or0c1hm0o72chh2bs)

My name is Harriet Hageman and, unlike Liz Cheney – who lives in Northern Virginia – Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his radical Democrats hate – they run absolutely counter to the elitist values of Cheney and her establishment backers.

Unfortunately, it's those establishment backers – including Never-Trumpers at the Lincoln Project and NeoCons like John Bolton and John Boehner – who are now going all-in to keep Cheney in power.

Case in point, just a few weeks ago, Cheney held a ritzy fundraiser with Mitt Romney where she charged $10,000 a head for VIPs . . .

_On top of the nearly $5 million in campaign cash she's amassed from a steady stream of Never-Trumpers and Democrats!_

That's right – even the billionaire cousin of Far-Left Illinois Governor JB Pritzker shelled out $20,000 for Cheney!

**My friend, with the Never-Trump arm of the establishment working night and day to keep Cheney in power, I'm going to need patriots like you to keep my campaign to defeat her going.**

[**So please, won't you give an emergency $35, $50, $75, or $100 donation to my campaign so I can go dollar for dollar with her elitist backers?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z8jm4viil00bmdkaj8odart58jv0bq69ai782eh8_rp22sh2s8i66or0c1hm0o72chh2bs)

It's unfortunately not hard to see why Democrats are teaming up with the establishment in taking Cheney's side.

Even before she voted to impeach President Trump on bogus charges in a sham hearing, she'd made it clear she sided with Big Government over _you_ .

Sure, she loves to go around appearing on CNN and _60 Minutes_ lecturing us about how "principled" she is, but there's nothing principled about betraying the 70% of Wyoming voters who voted for President Trump.

Nor is it "principled" to sit side-by-side with Nancy Pelosi in a Soviet-Style hearing that uses Big Government to punish conservatives as political prisoners!

My friend, there are dozens of issues Liz Cheney could be tackling instead of this sham January 6th commission.

She could be investigating Afghanistan and Joe Biden's incompetence.

She could be looking into Nancy Pelosi's spying on conservative representatives.

She could be questioning Dr. Fauci's dangerous Gain-of-Function research.

**But instead, she's scoring compliments from far-left anchors at CNN in her never-ending vendetta against President Trump and his supporters!**

[**There's no room in Wyoming, or the republican party for rabid anti-Trumpers who will sell out the constituents they represent for some positive press time from fake news stations like CNN, and I hope you'll help me.**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zck8rjvuapg8oeputtaloqdkgcp7aidsr51vba1o_rp22sh2s8i66or0c1hm0o72chh2bs)

As I said, loyalty and freedom still mean something here in Wyoming. While DC might be full of back-door deals and shifting political winds, the men and women of my state value the Cowboy ethos and ethic of riding for the brand.

You see, back in the old West, Cowboys gave their promise to stay loyal to the people who hired them. To the people who paid them.

They made a choice to fight for the brand as it was one of their own, to keep their word to the brand, and to never betray it.

As a DC insider, Liz Cheney knows nothing about that, but I do.

My family put down roots on a ranch outside of Laramie 1879, where we've raised cattle ever since.

Out here, we have a strong work ethic and fierce independence, and we don't take kindly to Big Government Socialists like Nancy Pelosi trying to control us.

It's why I've spent my professional life as a lawyer battling Big Government and federal agencies trying to usurp our rights, and why I'll do it in Washington, too.

I'm also:
* 100% Pro-Life
* A strong supporter of our Second Amendment
* Totally and Completely Against Vaccine Mandates
* Believe in the need to fight for our Election Integrity
* A believer in our fight for election integrity
* Committed to government transparency and ending wasteful spending!

My friend, these are the issues conservatives need to put front and center: _Not_ joining Nancy Pelosi in some anti-American tribunal designed to persecute fellow Americans!

[**So please, would you consider giving a $35, $50, $75, $100, $250, $500, $1,000, or $2,900 donation to my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney in the next 3 days?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zc686jubfqa9g1eaprgch7hlftv54td8jiuov6e8_rp22sh2s8i66or0c1hm0o72chh2bs)

As I told you earlier in this letter, Cheney has $5 million in campaign cash ready to bail her out in this race.

With each passing day more and more Democrats flock to her side, desperate to keep their war on President Trump and you going.

Because of that, I need your urgent financial support in the next 3 days.

Of course, if you can't quite afford to give $35 at this time, I understand

[**But know a gift of any amount lets me know you support my Trump-endorsed campaign against Cheney**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zq7dojq8ac7n9h5mnclibvr7thni5p3kf9iidci8_rp22sh2s8i66or0c1hm0o72chh2bs) **\--- and helps me crisscross the 97,914 square miles of Wyoming to talk to each and every voter in this state.**

My friend, I started by telling you how, out here in my home state of Wyoming, loyalty and freedom still mean something.

And even though you may not live here, I hope these values mean something to you, too. I look forward you your response. And I want to thank you for your support.

Respectfully,
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z7229gq0eketlpsmkvqvhsh5tkt1sf1c5612u3to_rp22sh2s8i66or0c1hm0o72chh2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

PS: Remember – Democrat megadonors are shelling out tens of thousands for Liz Cheney. But while she has the support of Democrats and establishment career politicians like Mitt Romney, she doesn't speak for you and me.

[**Will you help me prove that by sending her packing with a $35 or more campaign donation to my primary challenge?**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhcuilgg9l421qe45p887tpkmfgsp8lmm7ar9op8_rp22sh2s8i66or0c1hm0o72chh2bs) [DONATE](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zc43sqnebent2te0cjlq97ege3dvfcggqgqbuooo_rp22sh2s8i66or0c1hm0o72chh2bs)

| Athens, GA - Protect Freedom PAC, a Rand Paul affiliated Super PAC dedicated to supporting pro-liberty and freedom-minded candidates, announced that they will be running an independent campaign targeting Rep. Liz Cheney in her race for Congress in Wyoming. Senator Rand Paul has endorsed Cheney's opponent, Harriet Hageman.
The television campaign consists of nearly $250,000 statewide. The ad, which begins airing on August 10th, is titled ["Washington Elite."](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019DpDqdf4ETssK6n_GJK8QDYx1dDccj9Zu8OVluFjGZmM1qiG-b7HrMhZc-5Gwq_n18W6Y1qnSUNMWpJ9vBL5QAU9bOKUvBJVNrAOHyTVYfbBaBGiis3mIkL842ag82WDaa_cGKDo0CYPTF4ecULKKjPmMqi2eYDK8zRhH3RUW8hP3Tt8XA5tDQ==&c=peuH8Wd-whc1ieBcjA9DPRNIxOecA9uPbT_KnUQGUqwHUmhnBoxVxQ==&ch=LHR8rebkpUlct9TTSFsWnATD24GIrYpffb-WX9HapehgVDtMlSynsg==)
Transcript:
Who is Liz Cheney fighting for? Cheney's made a career working for the Washington Elite. Liz Cheney supported government spying on Americans, with no accountability... Partnered with Nancy Pelosi and the radical left to attack and demonize Republicans... And just like her father, Dick Cheney, Liz loves endless wars in the Middle East, costing us American lives and tax dollars. Liz Cheney fights for Washington, not Wyoming.
Protect Freedom PAC endorses and supports candidates for statewide and federal offices and has made independent expenditures totaling $12 million since 2018. The organization was founded by a team of veterans of the Donald Trump, Ron Paul, and Rand Paul campaigns for President.

---
| |
---
| Protect Freedom PAC was founded for the purpose of supporting pro-freedom and liberty-minded candidates using the tactics, technology, and strategy that best fits each race individually. PFP was founded by seasoned political veterans with decades of national campaign experience, which includes working on the campaigns of both Ron and Rand Paul.

| | Americans are all too familiar with the high cost of prescription drugs. **Big Pharma continues to raise the already sky-high cost of medications to continue posting record profits.** That's why I've been leading the charge in the Senate to lower prescription drug prices for Americans. And I'm proud to say that we've finally delivered. As Chairman of the Senate Committee responsible for Medicare, I've been working hard to negotiate legislation that will lower the cost of medications for seniors in Medicare and deliver much-needed relief to Americans' wallets. **I'm proud to say that this week, the Senate passed my historic legislation.** **** Here's a quick rundown of what's in the bill: **Medicare drug price negotiation**. This bill empowers the government to negotiate directly with drug companies to ensure seniors in Medicare get access to more affordable medicines. **Monthly out-of-pocket cap**. The legislation will cap the monthly out-of-pocket expenses for seniors in Medicare at $2,000. **Inflation cap.** This legislation will hold pharmaceutical companies accountable if they raise the price of their drugs faster than inflation. Once it becomes law, this bill will deliver real relief to Americans' wallets and hold Big Pharma accountable for mugging seniors at the pharmacy counter. **The American people elected Democrats to take big, bold action on the priorities that matter to families nationwide. I'm proud to say we're making good on those promises.** _Ron_ |

clean_body: | | | | Americans are all too familiar with the high cost of prescription drugs. Big Pharma continues to raise the already sky-high cost of medications to continue posting record profits. That's why I've been leading the charge in the Senate to lower prescription drug prices for Americans. And I'm proud to say that we've finally delivered. As Chairman of the Senate Committee responsible for Medicare, I've been working hard to negotiate legislation that will lower the cost of medications for seniors in Medicare and deliver much-needed relief to Americans' wallets. I'm proud to say that this week, the Senate passed my historic legislation. ** Here's a quick rundown of what's in the bill: Medicare drug price negotiation. This bill empowers the government to negotiate directly with drug companies to ensure seniors in Medicare get access to more affordable medicines. Monthly out-of-pocket cap. The legislation will cap the monthly out-of-pocket expenses for seniors in Medicare at $2,000. Inflation cap. This legislation will hold pharmaceutical companies accountable if they raise the price of their drugs faster than inflation. Once it becomes law, this bill will deliver real relief to Americans' wallets and hold Big Pharma accountable for mugging seniors at the pharmacy counter. The American people elected Democrats to take big, bold action on the priorities that matter to families nationwide. I'm proud to say we're making good on those promises. But when it does happen — when you get sick or injured — you shouldn’t have to worry about financial ruin on top of getting yourself well. As a breast cancer survivor, this issue is personal to me, and it’s a big reason I entered public service. I believe to my core that our health care system should put patients first — not special interests who want to use patients to maximize their own profits. I’m proud of the work that Jared and I have done together these last four years to save Coloradans money on health care: capping the cost of prescription drugs like insulin, cracking down on surprise out-of-network billing, reducing insurance premiums, and making behavioral health a major priority. **But here’s the reality: when it comes to health care in Colorado, who we have leading this state _really matters._** The progress we’ve made together wouldn’t have been possible if we hadn’t won the 2018 election. But when it does happen — when you get sick or injured — you shouldn’t have to worry about financial ruin on top of getting yourself well. As a breast cancer survivor, this issue is personal to me, and it’s a big reason I entered public service. I believe to my core that our health care system should put patients first — not special interests who want to use patients to maximize their own profits. I’m proud of the work that Jared and I have done together these last four years to save Coloradans money on health care: capping the cost of prescription drugs like insulin, cracking down on surprise out-of-network billing, reducing insurance premiums, and making behavioral health a major priority. But here’s the reality: when it comes to health care in Colorado, who we have leading this state really matters. ---
| | What the Inflation Reduction Act means for us
---
**Lilibet, resident of Westchester County:** _My mom sobbed on the stranger's shoulders and then told her she had no idea where to begin. That's when Catherine pulled out a pen and notepad and told her not to worry. She assured us that she was there to help and she wasn't going to leave until our family got it._ _When our family had nothing but each other after the Hurricane, our home destroyed by flooding, Catherine showed up and took care of us. She recruited volunteers to help with cleanup, she found us housing, she got us connected to the local food bank. At our family’s lowest point, Catherine was there to lift us up._
---
| |
---
| | Yesterday we were joined in Mamaroneck by Catherine Parker, local electeds and fellow flood survivors from across the district, who have personally experienced major flooding events caused by climate change, calling on the House to see the Inflation Reduction Act through to the President’s signature. The work Catherine has done at the County level has been and will continue to be important but we must take that same dedication to Congress. **Lou Young, Deputy Mayor, Village of Mamaroneck:**_This issue is so important because our_ _community is in the floodplain. We got 8 1⁄2” of rain after Ida and the rivers overflowed, destroying our roads, bridges, homes, and businesses. Catherine Parker has been a critical leader in ensuring that_ _communities like ours receive the necessary funding to improve our infrastructure._ **ICYMI: Watch it here!**

| | Dear fellow American,
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid.
While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law.
Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.”
By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly—plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun.
That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.”**
Through**“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.
---

Your tax-deductible gift will help promote our free online courses and other educational outreach efforts in this critical time for our nation. And your gift matters even more because...
Hillsdale accomplishes all its work while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

Fellow Pro-Life American, The recent overturning of the disastrous _Roe v. Wade_ decision that enabled the killing of over 60 million babies was a blessing from God - one of the most amazing victories for biblical values in our lifetime. We at ADF are proud to be a part of the legal team that secured this historic, generational win - a victory only made possible by the prayerful and generous support of friends just like you! Fellow Patriot,
Biden’s DOJ is hankering to have the federal courts overturn a ruling so they can force health care providers to provide gender transitioning care even if that violates their religious beliefs.

Biden’s HHS is moving to fortify rules that would force insurance providers who receive federal funding to pay for sex change procedures.

Biden’s HHS Assistant Secretary, Rachel Levine, has joined in arguments that sex change procedures, including the use of puberty blockers, cross-sex hormones, and surgeries are medically necessary, and stated that new federal rulemaking “is especially key when it comes to providing services like gender-affirming care for trans youth”.

This obscene federal overreach violates religious liberties, puts the lives of confused youth in jeopardy, forces health professionals to violate their Hippocratic Oath, and burdens a recession ridden economy with more government imposed costs!

While bureaucratic operatives decry nationalism and patriotism as archaic barbarism, patriotic Americans know that if we do not fight against the Radical Left initiatives seeking to attack the very fabric of our human traditions, our country will descend into complete moral decay.

Your vote for me will be for an elected official who will stand up to the Biden Administration’s harrowing attempts to impose a Radical Left agenda on our youth, and our nation at large.

As your next Congressman, I will reject the degenerate radicalism on display by the Biden Administration. Together we can reestablish the presence of Judeo-Christian ethics being exercised in the halls of Congress and the White House!

With your support of my campaign in a generous donation of any amount today, I will be strengthened to protect the legacy of our national motto: In God We Trust!

Team,
During the 2020 impeachment of former President Trump, Elissa had to get very comfortable with one thing: the prospect that she might lose her next race.
She was in a district that had voted for President Trump, and in town hall after town hall, his supporters expressed their anger at the impeachment trial. Nonetheless, Elissa held to her convictions and took the vote she felt was right for the country.
Elissa was re-elected in 2020, but getting very comfortable with losing her seat freed her up to focus on doing what was right for the country, not drilling down on ideology and trying to win another election.
In recent years, Republican Congresswoman Liz Cheney has turned into a symbol of those same values. As much as Elissa may disagree with Congresswoman Cheney on policy, her work on the January 6th committee and willingness to vote against the former president (in a state where his popularity remains high) exemplifies the higher calling of doing what’s best for our country.
In a New York Times article last weekend, Congresswoman Cheney said this:

name: U.S. Senator Chris Murphy
subject: Will you give me a chance to explain why your donation to John Fetterman’s campaign is so important?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Flipping Pennsylvania is without a doubt one of our best chances to pick up a seat in November.
#
$5. That’s the donation I’m asking you to make to John Fetterman’s Senate campaign in Pennsylvania, Derek.
I hope you’ll give me a chance to explain why your support is so important in a moment. But if you already know what’s at stake and that this is our best chance to flip a seat in November, then you can use this link to contribute:
[**_https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220809-1?refcode=em20220809-1_**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220809-1?refcode=em20220809-6797&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6797_434096_L_4Jwr&akid=6797%2E434096%2EL_4Jwr)
As you know, Democrats have the slimmest possible majority in the Senate. It’s made it difficult to make meaningful progress on a number of important issues — from climate action to defending our democracy and the right to vote. But Republicans being put back in charge would be an absolute disaster and dangerous for all of us. So we need to look for our best chances to make sure that doesn’t happen.
Flipping Pennsylvania is without a doubt one of our best chances to pick up a seat in November. It could be the seat that expands the majority and makes it possible to pass more significant legislation through the Senate. Frankly, if one of our incumbents loses, it could be the seat we need to save the majority from Mitch McConnell.
The good news here is that this race is extremely winnable.
Dr. Oz is a TV star who has spent years grifting off of people’s health concerns to sell “quack treatments.” He’s praised the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn Roe v. Wade and pushed Trump’s big lie. Not only does he not share Pennsylvanians’ values, he doesn’t even live in the state!
Meanwhile, John Fetterman is a great candidate. He understands what working people need, and he’s dedicated to fighting for a better future for our families. He got his start in politics by running for mayor of Braddock in response to gun violence that plagued his hometown. And in the Senate, he will not be afraid to end the filibuster to pass legislation that can protect our rights and democracy and shift the balance of power back toward working people.
But Republican super PACs have limitless sums of money from billionaires and wealthy corporations, and they will spend anything it takes attacking John to try to hold this seat. It’s important that we ensure John has the resources to fight back.
[**_So if you can, please make a $5 donation to John Fetterman’s campaign to flip Pennsylvania’s Senate seat. We cannot afford to let Dr. Oz anywhere near this seat and put the gavel back in Mitch McConnell’s hand._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220809-1?refcode=em20220809-6797&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6797_434096_L_4Jwr&akid=6797%2E434096%2EL_4Jwr)
Thank you very much for donating and doing everything you can to help John win in November. It means a lot to me that we can count on your support.
Every best wish,
Chris Murphy

Friends, When I decided to run for U.S. Senate, I knew that my path here would be different than most. I don't come from a wealthy family. body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49000641/360420231/-382861100?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM2YzJiN2JlLTBjMTgtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6600rLBH32jiSCwaO2ufVU7GiKMl6gP3WP4QJansUxs=&emci=a401458c-7417-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=36c2b7be-0c18-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230) | | | Hi there, Amazing news— the Inflation Reduction Act, and the crucial climate provisions it holds have successfully passed the U.S. Senate! Now, it’s headed towards a vote from the U.S. House of Representatives. _We’re so close, and have come so far. Help us get this historic climate bill across the finish line this week.__**[Will you send a message to your U.S. representative urging them to fight for our climate by voting “yes” on the Inflation Reduction Act?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49000642/360420234/-382861100?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM2YzJiN2JlLTBjMTgtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6600rLBH32jiSCwaO2ufVU7GiKMl6gP3WP4QJansUxs=&emci=a401458c-7417-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=36c2b7be-0c18-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)**_ This bill represents a major turning point in the battle for our country’s climate. As Senate Majority Leader Schumer announced, it has the potential to shave down carbon emissions in the United States by as much as 40% by 2030. One way this bill would accomplish this is by investing more in creating clean, renewable energy sources on U.S. soil. This will create reliable networks of emission-free power that can sustain our infrastructure through drastic climate-induced weather events _WHILE_ saving Americans countless dollars on energy bills. _**[We need you to ask your representative to pass the bill right away to make room for clean energy and the economic benefits that accompany it.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49000643/360420235/-382861100?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM2YzJiN2JlLTBjMTgtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6600rLBH32jiSCwaO2ufVU7GiKMl6gP3WP4QJansUxs=&emci=a401458c-7417-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=36c2b7be-0c18-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)**_ In addition, the game-changing climate pieces of the Inflation Reduction Act will create **millions** of jobs in the production of clean energy and climate-friendly infrastructure, benefitting our national economy as well as BIPOC (Black, Indigenous, and People of Color) and low-income communities who need a federal commitment to environmental justice the most. Some skeptics have expressed apprehension about flaws in the bill, noting that it isn’t as hard on fossil fuel companies as it should be, and we agree this bill is not perfect. Yet despite its imperfections, the Inflation Reduction Act tackles climate change and environmental justice at a scale we haven’t seen before. Climate change will only get worse if urgent action isn’t taken immediately, so _**[we must contact the House of Representatives and push them to do everything in their power to pass this bill.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49000644/360420236/-382861100?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM2YzJiN2JlLTBjMTgtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6600rLBH32jiSCwaO2ufVU7GiKMl6gP3WP4QJansUxs=&emci=a401458c-7417-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=36c2b7be-0c18-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=2107230)**_ Thank you for never giving up! Lindsey Scholten, Deputy Director, OLCV. |

Now, it’s headed towards a vote from the U.S. House of Representatives. We’re so close, and have come so far. Help us get this historic climate bill across the finish line this week. This bill represents a major turning point in the battle for our country’s climate. As Senate Majority Leader Schumer announced, it has the potential to shave down carbon emissions in the United States by as much as 40% by 2030. One way this bill would accomplish this is by investing more in creating clean, renewable energy sources on U.S. soil. This will create reliable networks of emission-free power that can sustain our infrastructure through drastic climate-induced weather events WHILE saving Americans countless dollars on energy bills. In addition, the game-changing climate pieces of the Inflation Reduction Act will create millions of jobs in the production of clean energy and climate-friendly infrastructure, benefitting our national economy as well as BIPOC (Black, Indigenous, and People of Color) and low-income communities who need a federal commitment to environmental justice the most. Some skeptics have expressed apprehension about flaws in the bill, noting that it isn’t as hard on fossil fuel companies as it should be, and we agree this bill is not perfect. Yet despite its imperfections, the Inflation Reduction Act tackles climate change and environmental justice at a scale we haven’t seen before. Climate change will only get worse if urgent action isn’t taken immediately, so Thank you for never giving up! [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49000882/360420414/1827709641?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220809_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNGY2NzJjYi0wYzE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XytUMGQReG3885V0qxHtcKUPsTTq17s_mU_3mqDCOMk=) Friend, On Sunday, we passed the _Inflation Reduction Act_ in the Senate after overcoming hours of cynical GOP obstruction. This is a victory for Coloradans and for the American people over corporate special interests and the status quo. The bill will lower costs for families at the pharmacy, at the gas pump, and on their monthly energy bills and health insurance premiums. And now, we’re one step closer to energy independence and leading the fight against climate change. Here’s what the IRA will do:
* **_Lower prescription drug and health care costs_** , by allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices — and cap prescription drug costs for seniors at $2,000 a year. Julia from Denver told me that her dad has a heart condition, and he pays $6,000 a month for medication — that’s $72,000 a year for something he needs to take for the rest of his life. That’s outrageous and ends with this bill.
* **_Build a fairer tax code_** by making sure the 200 biggest corporations that report over $1 billion in profit pay their fair share. Colorado teachers, firefighters and police officers shouldn’t be paying more in taxes than Amazon. It’s no wonder most Americans think our tax code is rigged. This comes directly from a bill I helped write.
* **_Make a historic investment in climate and clean energy_** — that includes funding to address droughts in the West and the Colorado River Basin and restore the health of our forests and prevent wildfires. This bill will boost American manufacturing for wind, solar, and batteries to power electric vehicles and our energy grid. When you put it all together, this bill will put us on track to reduce climate pollution by 40% by the end of the decade.

For decades, Washington’s economic agenda has been pretty simple: Let the big corporations do whatever they want and call it “freedom;” slash investments in working families, and cut taxes for the wealthiest individuals. That left us with income inequality higher than any time since the 1920s and a country that charges families more for health care than most industrialized nations — where seniors are forced to cut their pills in half or skip their prescriptions. We’re left with a nation that is still shackled to a global fossil fuel market dictated by tyrants like Vladimir Putin, despite our abundant resources at home and the urgent threat of climate change. **With this bill, we are showing that government can deliver for working people, not the wealthy and big corporations.** I’m more hopeful than ever that we can leave Colorado and our country better for the next generation and build an economy that grows for everyone. Sincerely, Michael P.S. I’m facing a tough re-election campaign, but when I’m re-elected, I’ll continue fighting to protect our environment for generations to come. But first, I’ve got to win this election, and I need your help. **[Pitch in $10 to fight back against GOP attack ads, win this race, and build on the wins I’ve secured for Colorado’s families.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49000889/360420415/1827709641?refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220809_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNGY2NzJjYi0wYzE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XytUMGQReG3885V0qxHtcKUPsTTq17s_mU_3mqDCOMk=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | ******[Donate $10 now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49000890/360420416/1827709641?express_lane=true&amount=10&&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&zip=18326&phone=&employer=&occupation=&refcode=AU_MFB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20220809_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNGY2NzJjYi0wYzE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XytUMGQReG3885V0qxHtcKUPsTTq17s_mU_3mqDCOMk=)******

clean_body: The bill will lower costs for families at the pharmacy, at the gas pump, and on their monthly energy bills and insurance premiums. | = = Friend, On Sunday, we passed the Inflation Reduction Act in the Senate after overcoming hours of cynical GOP obstruction. This is a victory for Coloradans and for the American people over corporate special interests and the status quo. The bill will lower costs for families at the pharmacy, at the gas pump, and on their monthly energy bills and health insurance premiums. And now, we’re one step closer to energy independence and leading the fight against climate change. Here’s what the IRA will do: Lower prescription drug and health care costs , by allowing Medicare to negotiate drug prices — and cap prescription drug costs for seniors at $2,000 a year. Julia from Denver told me that her dad has a heart condition, and he pays $6,000 a month for medication — that’s $72,000 a year for something he needs to take for the rest of his life. That’s outrageous and ends with this bill. Build a fairer tax code by making sure the 200 biggest corporations that report over $1 billion in profit pay their fair share. Colorado teachers, firefighters and police officers shouldn’t be paying more in taxes than Amazon. It’s no wonder most Americans think our tax code is rigged. This comes directly from a bill I helped write. Make a historic investment in climate and clean energy — that includes funding to address droughts in the West and the Colorado River Basin and restore the health of our forests and prevent wildfires. This bill will boost American manufacturing for wind, solar, and batteries to power electric vehicles and our energy grid. When you put it all together, this bill will put us on track to reduce climate pollution by 40% by the end of the decade. For decades, Washington’s economic agenda has been pretty simple: Let the big corporations do whatever they want and call it “freedom;” slash investments in working families, and cut taxes for the wealthiest individuals. That left us with income inequality higher than any time since the 1920s and a country that charges families more for health care than most industrialized nations — where seniors are forced to cut their pills in half or skip their prescriptions. We’re left with a nation that is still shackled to a global fossil fuel market dictated by tyrants like Vladimir Putin, despite our abundant resources at home and the urgent threat of climate change. With this bill, we are showing that government can deliver for working people, not the wealthy and big corporations. I’m more hopeful than ever that we can leave Colorado and our country better for the next generation and build an economy that grows for everyone. Sincerely, Michael P.S. I’m facing a tough re-election campaign, but when I’m re-elected, I’ll continue fighting to protect our environment for generations to come. body:
**[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=9f2036285f95424a9716249ba26459d1&_e=WQkg3YUqf8p3a5YQPtXokoUOE32xcZ9veOegaGnRUt45XqMYQaRYB0ME6HdJW0GHMqmmNz8Z9zhVIX9AH0qt2TpgWG69l4CFwib2IayY__YG7ojYwRs8-3t5AaQokLNpnFwnyKCdqXpGYqKb9C4hT0JfXWXFDY5RQmTq7H6eu02OABA_QSS9z5Z7-6jqV67mB-ceb7hP6-mxIJ1prog0zqF04bcae6GYWnD0J_oKkhM3bgG4hOhnVbAcHk7FdSu5rrGd4o0__GamH4ZMyi-9hVQHusop4IC5JKLcuj_Dp2QzU4jxzaGhwAgb83WmjtdXSUgmzsq7rH1Z48ViO-Wac0ELJ0As3C8JxrxTbJ3YV9KiPmTQsqrXrJsyM9uKiPkB6MZ_lelBlHEUKZ-rqZP3Knkz6RPTMh5jQldZNKdwSls%3D)**

Peter,
Our enemy is out of the shadows, and they are not limiting their attack on our values and our culture to the halls of government. We've seen the woke mob attack institution by institution as they look for more ways to impose their radical agenda on the American people.

The target today? Infiltrating the American companies and finding ways to make them bow to their will.

The new movement, the so-called Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG), is infiltrating boardrooms across the country. But don't let its banal name fool you -- it's a concerted effort to get companies to make decisions based on how closely they align with liberal orthodoxy even when it's not in the best interest of consumers, employees, or shareholders.

**_[PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=9f2036285f95424a9716249ba26459d1&_e=WQkg3YUqf8p3a5YQPtXokoUOE32xcZ9veOegaGnRUt45XqMYQaRYB0ME6HdJW0GHMqmmNz8Z9zhVIX9AH0qt2TpgWG69l4CFwib2IayY__YG7ojYwRs8-3t5AaQokLNpnFwnyKCdqXpGYqKb9C4hT0JfXWXFDY5RQmTq7H6eu02OABA_QSS9z5Z7-6jqV67mB-ceb7hP6-mxIJ1prog0zmj5AEcHyK0BGRriEZHfGyQ1DXLH3-e6HUeqPw0iOwh92w81M-nrNLWvBx6gNoGVJKfO3shL6dAxL9MpsPd3cuGv3jBf17o0HEvSlqSG3RXR1rbAc1vy4rYrKYC-_lp0ZyfIcXM018BdpfujmEereid5eFr8w8dpsWPCqVXbwDfJNtjZWuqoVogSOd40_vD_wHJ1inSc2SepLN2-Ng5f7qE%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=6d0ad4f0c05f461646dec5d9a57579f45c646d2682c143cdeebf21f19c8c327da15d7461a0cafbb632d41a9c01e7b1221b2000a2d4a3dc14")_**

The Left has conditioned its mob, everyone from anarchists who toss Molotov cocktails at police to its army of woke Twitter zombies, to raise their pitchforks at any company that dares to defy them.

And it's working. Whether they are hostages or collaborators, companies and CEOs are bowing to this pressure. They're going woke. **_And the consequences are dire._**

As Governor, I'm making sure we fight back. This isn't just about politics. There are real lives being hurt by this. **Teachers, first responders, and people who have trusted the state of Florida with their pensions are seeing their savings and their future eroded in the interest of a group of _Left-wing activists who couldn 't run a lemonade stand._**

We made a great stride here at home, and I think it can be a model for how other states start standing up for their citizens over the radical Left's agenda. Now, in Florida, we've prohibited state fund managers from investing the state of Florida's money based on political factors.

We want them to invest the state's money in the best interest of the beneficiaries of those funds, and we are going to require fund managers to only consider maximizing the return on investment on behalf of Florida's retirees. That's what the people of Florida deserve.

**_[AGREE? PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=9f2036285f95424a9716249ba26459d1&_e=WQkg3YUqf8p3a5YQPtXokoUOE32xcZ9veOegaGnRUt45XqMYQaRYB0ME6HdJW0GHMqmmNz8Z9zhVIX9AH0qt2TpgWG69l4CFwib2IayY__YG7ojYwRs8-3t5AaQokLNpnFwnyKCdqXpGYqKb9C4hT0JfXWXFDY5RQmTq7H6eu02OABA_QSS9z5Z7-6jqV67mB-ceb7hP6-mxIJ1prog0znLUvMjLuQtFNJ3fR82D210n7lvcJogfhG1Ct2P2wdxAOhtOhkv_gBMLcLPWZASXVvVJdu07NfuM_-3LRna1_-VGyqXC7fYNBv0GnmC-AvDqu_ORFlxXCEJmdCqbt5O5-592Utopu_-XhhjWukJGdsFrq4tRhE9qi4pgHOqPsIPUgzui8QI-V_0BUn7FGw_kZpc1_vI4VDePReo99FNgVYs%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=6d0ad4f0c05f461684d706e26ae50bcac793ee8e08c95e2e1feec8b4aa658e3d7b020a07abf143039884a7c65c4b11f6187ec269bc2a1d9d")_**

**But we didn 't stop there.** We also took aim at one of the Left's favorite new forms of censorship: preventing access to financial services. That's right, the new move is to make it painful for banks or payment processors like Visa or PayPal to do business with groups they don't like. They want to choke off the ability of businesses they don't agree with from being able to buy and sell goods.

That's not happening in Florida. I'm not letting Wall Street banks or credit card companies discriminate against people for any religious, political, or social beliefs. The reality is every time the economy is politicized, the end result is more market share for monopolistic legacy operators and crushing burdens on the small- and medium-sized business whose survival is critical to our communities and to our entrepreneurial spirit as a nation. This is as much an attack on the little guy and on the average consumer as it is an attack on conservatism.

These reforms seem simple, right? Common sense. I think so, too. But it hasn't stopped the Left from attacking me. That's why I had to write you today.

The Left has captured a lot of ground, and they've gotten many companies to agree to their demands, and with that complicity comes a great deal of money. The money being spent to stop what we're doing in Florida and to keep conservative victories like this from happening is immense. Every faceless liberal alphabet group you can think of, along with George Soros and Hollywood liberals, are spending money to defeat me while the legacy corporate media fabricates lies and half-truths to try and paint our successes - successes that look like common sense to average Americans - as the radical position.

I have no doubt that the Left will spend MILLIONS trying to stop me from being re-elected. They want you and every other Republican and conservative in the country to sit down and shut up. To stop standing up for conservative principles. To stop advancing the cause of individual liberty. That's why I need your help. That's why I need you to donate today. We need to be able to fully fund the defense against the woke mob.

Florida has led the way on some of the most critical issues to conservatives over the last few years.
* **Fighting the Fauci fanatics.**

clean_body: Peter, Our enemy is out of the shadows, and they are not limiting their attack on our values and our culture to the halls of government. We've seen the woke mob attack institution by institution as they look for more ways to impose their radical agenda on the American people. The target today? Infiltrating the American companies and finding ways to make them bow to their will. The new movement, the so-called Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG), is infiltrating boardrooms across the country. | Athens, GA - Protect Freedom PAC, a Rand Paul affiliated Super PAC dedicated to supporting pro-liberty and freedom-minded candidates, announced that they have launched an independent campaign in support of Sarah Palin in Alaska. Senator Rand Paul has endorsed Palin.
The full campaign includes more than $400,000 in expenditures for television, digital advertising, and direct voter contact.
The television component of the campaign features an ad titled, ["Stand Firm."](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0015mUKOKRWYoDnWR7MaRoA0G8_KkMt6sCWBV8sMLguA-LD8xiAZHGdhxRh1_2rkaH7LXjg7UQbLeJVH1AEDGOjWzeQqpI6I_ZB2fqwy4fNrGxh12aR68f5qvTP3tLxOcbd8-5D8Zd3qT57mrqBBcuMwQ==&c=hIOpL4JSv-FVRARROTVgM89xsVs5ROmmBjOUcATS2Gee8S_f6sCmPQ==&ch=3gH5jzX86VviHA-s6g1j_NAN1JDDws0a41ImF-oEvMs-2oMZs_zBDQ==)
Transcript:
Joe Biden and the radical left want to destroy our country. But America First Conservative Sarah Palin won't let them. That's why Sarah Palin is the only candidate endorsed by President Donald Trump and Conservative Rand Paul. In Congress, Palin will stand firm to lower inflation... ...unlock America's energy potential... ...and safeguard our values. America First Trump Conservative... Sarah Palin for Congress.
Protect Freedom PAC endorses and supports candidates for statewide and federal offices and has made independent expenditures totaling $12 million since 2018. The organization was founded by a team of veterans of the Donald Trump, Ron Paul, and Rand Paul campaigns for President.
---
| |
---
| Protect Freedom PAC was founded for the purpose of supporting pro-freedom and liberty-minded candidates using the tactics, technology, and strategy that best fits each race individually. PFP was founded by seasoned political veterans with decades of national campaign experience, which includes working on the campaigns of both Ron and Rand Paul.

> Vikram For N.H Weekly Newsletter
> August 9, 2022
---
Vikram Visits BOTH SIDES of the Southern Border
Vikram recently traveled to the U.S.-Mexico border and saw first-hand the problems America is experiencing as part of the Joe Biden-Maggie Hassan border security and immigration crisis. He met with business and political leaders in Texas and New Mexico and spent time on both the Mexican and American sides of the border. One of the more insightful findings of his trip was that it was easier for humans to cross the border illegally than cattle. That's right, livestock are inspected, tagged, and must have their papers in order to cross the border. As he says in the video linked below, "we have a secure border, at least for cattle."
From the need to finish the wall, protect our country from the inflow of drugs, criminals and terrorists, and to safely conduct legitimate business with Latin American countries, there is so much to be done. Vikram is the son of two working-class immigrants who proudly recall handing in their green cards to get their naturalization papers, after taking an oath to the United States. It's time to send someone to Washington who understands America is a shining city on a hill, a welcoming and generous nation, that compassionately welcomes those seeking a better life. These thoughts are not in opposition to a secure border. As Vikram notes, he's for a "tall wall and a wide gate." We must stop the illegal immigration.
