But things have changed in our state, and not for the better. Gretchen Whitmer and her far-Left policies have devastated Michigan over the last four years, and especially during her unscientific, tyrannical lockdowns in 2020. An entire generation of students was set up for failure when Whitmer locked the doors to every school in our state. People have lost their jobs, businesses, and life savings. I’ve visited with the restaurant owners, the barbers, the florists, and the long list of small businesses and workers who were denied the ability to make a living because Whitmer thought she knew better. I’ve talked with the men and women who lost their jobs, or closed their businesses, because they just couldn’t make it work with the “closed by Whitmer” sign on the front door. The Queen of Lockdowns decided that YOU were not essential – and then she turned around and broke her own rules when it suited her. I lost my grandmother in a nursing home during Whitmer’s lockdown, and I wasn’t even allowed into the room to say goodbye. My daughters and I were forced to peek through a window. These policies were cruel, and they did NOTHING to protect public health and safety. It’s been a long four years, but this November, we finally have a chance to hold her accountable. We can finally bring America First leadership to Michigan and get our state back on track. Whitmer is cheering every disastrous Biden policy that has plunged us into a recession. She’s driven the price of groceries through the roof. And that’s just for the groceries you can actually find on the shelf! Baby formula? Who needs it, right? Families are struggling just to put food on the table. But the truth is, Whitmer doesn’t care! Her policy proposals include shutting down pipelines, and she tried to RAISE the gas tax. She’s an eager participant in Biden’s insane war on our domestic energy industry. This comes at a time when the average gas price in Michigan is well over $4 a gallon! When Whitmer finally reopened our schools, she poisoned our children’s minds with crazy left-wing anti-American ideas like critical race theory and radical gender theory. She doesn’t want parents to have any say in their children’s education! Whitmer has embraced the “spirit” of the defund-the-police movement, even as violent crime in Michigan increases at DOUBLE the rate of the national average. She’s happily put the safety of our communities in jeopardy to appease her far-Left base! With a track record like that, you’d think her defeat would be assured in November... ...but national Democrats are desperate to keep control of this key swing state. They know it could decide the 2024 elections, so they want to make sure they have a far-Left puppet who can put her finger on the scales to hurt President Trump and swing the election towards Democrats. That’s why they’ve poured millions of dollars into Michigan to prop up Whitmer. She’s currently sitting on a war chest of over $14.7 MILLION, and she’s going to spend every penny of it to try to torpedo our surging campaign. We need to be prepared for an onslaught of lying attack ads, and we need to secure the funds to FIGHT BACK. That’s where you come in, Friend. I know you’re a patriot who supports President Trump, Ron DeSantis, and other conservative leaders. You believed in them and helped them win tough battles when no one thought it was possible. Now, I need you to help me win what will be one of the toughest battles in the country this November. I know something about tough battles. This primary was a tough fight. Fighting and beating breast cancer was a tough fight. Running and growing a Michigan-based steel company, as a woman, was tough. Watching my Nana locked away and left to die in a nursing home was tough. But as the saying goes, when the times get tough, the tough get going. I am tough, and I am just getting going. With America First patriots like YOU fighting alongside me, we’re going to take back our state from the radical Left and lay the groundwork to take back the White House in 2024. The battlelines in this race couldn’t be any clearer. This is going to be an epic fight between a conservative businesswoman and mother, and a far-Left birthing parent and career politician. To win, I’m going to need your support, Friend. I don’t have liberal megadonors like Whitmer. Grassroots conservatives like you are all I’ve got. | Dear Friend,What a summer this has been for me and my family!I want to thank you so much for your efforts on behalf of my campaign. I truly appreciate your support - this would not be possible without you.I hope you have followed along and seen our ads, signs, mailers and media coverage. Our campaign team is committed to winning this election.With just two weeks to go, we are busier than ever meeting voters and working from morning until midnight. In this crowded primary, my opponents are now spending their energy and resources attacking each other - while I remain focused on issues facing our country. That is exactly what I intend to do in Washington.I am asking for help. Please let me know if you are available to volunteer with neighborhood walks, early voting and election day precinct support, as well as, residential and commercial sign locations. I have particularly enjoyed meeting voters at small gatherings, at homes, businesses and even get togethers at coffee shops.**If you want to help,**[**click here**](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=62f2ab60eab14f3c33a991f5&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tededwardsforcongress.com%2Fvolunteer%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D62f158e03138402e510eb7c2%26ss_email_id%3D62f2ab60eab14f3c33a991f5%26ss_campaign_name%3DJust%2Btwo%2Bweeks%25E2%2580%25A6%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2022-08-09T18%253A57%253A56Z&w=62a23ccb05070a1330f6e585&l=en-US&s=O-wBPL0rkJckfz-6-fCs4VMxvdk%3D)**, or just reply to this email and I will follow-up.** Thank you for time and help. Over the next 14 days, please continue to spread the word and keep us in your prayers.I look forward to the opportunity to serve you in Washington.My very best,
---
|
---

body:
**[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=01be4aabe2a04990aab40a34d05fd2d7&_e=2MbiMEemLrTAeyzb_xJYzN3-JTsfkuA-yrPXRXklORWxM5qyyPc1lDlotkxbJyZSF1hGy1SEgL4MSmIHwGTF75Zenfvt_7UVYieYsExBqg7_NZNKHYnKhiE_UBGRDqp5HHplzQv1V390sX-0XcvcDfJ7znlZip-PtfWXRFKJ54Nyd1Iosi8jT8RTLibz1x5gdpM2f_Z71mzmBPVHRopdQsEzDubgqEq_7YHPmQn5RI0hRpVdyS1xK1pBeOqlnHP9KaQJHBLBdNzM01yquHe1eKWqvDJLrx9kmIiYq7v3e3Xo-zyJGYJ-yLyO0_PEz-08eQQ12n5MeylKbaXF5awvedC0Lc1rjBm7zkgfJXDCSjHwqnq325LgENxxWQwDpEAEw3h46pHtQW0vIk8d3-7PV67dmY8-3cyOYXH9dcCnYco%3D)**

Peter,
Our enemy is out of the shadows, and they are not limiting their attack on our values and our culture to the halls of government. We've seen the woke mob attack institution by institution as they look for more ways to impose their radical agenda on the American people.

The target today? Infiltrating the American companies and finding ways to make them bow to their will.

The new movement, the so-called Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG), is infiltrating boardrooms across the country. But don't let its banal name fool you -- it's a concerted effort to get companies to make decisions based on how closely they align with liberal orthodoxy even when it's not in the best interest of consumers, employees, or shareholders.

**_[PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=01be4aabe2a04990aab40a34d05fd2d7&_e=2MbiMEemLrTAeyzb_xJYzN3-JTsfkuA-yrPXRXklORWxM5qyyPc1lDlotkxbJyZSF1hGy1SEgL4MSmIHwGTF75Zenfvt_7UVYieYsExBqg7_NZNKHYnKhiE_UBGRDqp5HHplzQv1V390sX-0XcvcDfJ7znlZip-PtfWXRFKJ54Nyd1Iosi8jT8RTLibz1x5gdpM2f_Z71mzmBPVHRopdQhq_P6qlH7tF1sfkZk6B0vIrQAG_97HCV0As9tcarrlx3Zufv_JCuP-FpuNJrkaHaaG0Ciis9Ak6T84BPTCK5Xbq82HAhzOByKBZ2nKqtrOpMqjUsXhxViLw6BoOEa7JV9l7FaCeuDlcqI44tLV4Crj2UsguqsvcjCmyWn5sU5bTLBmqhBSxi_4irXH-gqinRM_YJIGFeYnZ2uJ4sILGmXw%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=6d0ad4f0c05f461646dec5d9a57579f45c646d2682c143cdeebf21f19c8c327da15d7461a0cafbb632d41a9c01e7b1221b2000a2d4a3dc14")_**

The Left has conditioned its mob, everyone from anarchists who toss Molotov cocktails at police to its army of woke Twitter zombies, to raise their pitchforks at any company that dares to defy them.

And it's working. Whether they are hostages or collaborators, companies and CEOs are bowing to this pressure. They're going woke. **_And the consequences are dire._**

As Governor, I'm making sure we fight back. This isn't just about politics. There are real lives being hurt by this. **Teachers, first responders, and people who have trusted the state of Florida with their pensions are seeing their savings and their future eroded in the interest of a group of _Left-wing activists who couldn 't run a lemonade stand._**

We made a great stride here at home, and I think it can be a model for how other states start standing up for their citizens over the radical Left's agenda. Now, in Florida, we've prohibited state fund managers from investing the state of Florida's money based on political factors.

We want them to invest the state's money in the best interest of the beneficiaries of those funds, and we are going to require fund managers to only consider maximizing the return on investment on behalf of Florida's retirees. That's what the people of Florida deserve.

**_[AGREE? PITCH IN NOW: STOP THE WOKE CORPORATE CAPTURE>>>](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=01be4aabe2a04990aab40a34d05fd2d7&_e=2MbiMEemLrTAeyzb_xJYzN3-JTsfkuA-yrPXRXklORWxM5qyyPc1lDlotkxbJyZSF1hGy1SEgL4MSmIHwGTF75Zenfvt_7UVYieYsExBqg7_NZNKHYnKhiE_UBGRDqp5HHplzQv1V390sX-0XcvcDfJ7znlZip-PtfWXRFKJ54Nyd1Iosi8jT8RTLibz1x5gdpM2f_Z71mzmBPVHRopdQlbQXKpcOpqVOECocgxBIM7q2fz9rgU9P_GlapG4xCmx5EQi_FTDUXstsxOLY2bz7n-lr8E58kNRbIkSL_K4BGnSZkPfnluVSsvLOPyo-P2WjzIFjRU26s1biJ0IW65--9I-jdC-ssEeS3qZwX_9HLg8qbEtzZcmHmf1B51uo1v0BlAzo9guBQRLwov7uPcYYFo0txW0n2Y5rbS88YVxt5M%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=6d0ad4f0c05f461684d706e26ae50bcac793ee8e08c95e2e1feec8b4aa658e3d7b020a07abf143039884a7c65c4b11f6187ec269bc2a1d9d")_**

**But we didn 't stop there.** We also took aim at one of the Left's favorite new forms of censorship: preventing access to financial services. That's right, the new move is to make it painful for banks or payment processors like Visa or PayPal to do business with groups they don't like. They want to choke off the ability of businesses they don't agree with from being able to buy and sell goods.

That's not happening in Florida. I'm not letting Wall Street banks or credit card companies discriminate against people for any religious, political, or social beliefs. The reality is every time the economy is politicized, the end result is more market share for monopolistic legacy operators and crushing burdens on the small- and medium-sized business whose survival is critical to our communities and to our entrepreneurial spirit as a nation. This is as much an attack on the little guy and on the average consumer as it is an attack on conservatism.

These reforms seem simple, right? Common sense. I think so, too. But it hasn't stopped the Left from attacking me. That's why I had to write you today.

The Left has captured a lot of ground, and they've gotten many companies to agree to their demands, and with that complicity comes a great deal of money. The money being spent to stop what we're doing in Florida and to keep conservative victories like this from happening is immense. Every faceless liberal alphabet group you can think of, along with George Soros and Hollywood liberals, are spending money to defeat me while the legacy corporate media fabricates lies and half-truths to try and paint our successes - successes that look like common sense to average Americans - as the radical position.

I have no doubt that the Left will spend MILLIONS trying to stop me from being re-elected. They want you and every other Republican and conservative in the country to sit down and shut up. To stop standing up for conservative principles. To stop advancing the cause of individual liberty. That's why I need your help. That's why I need you to donate today. We need to be able to fully fund the defense against the woke mob.

Florida has led the way on some of the most critical issues to conservatives over the last few years.
* **Fighting the Fauci fanatics.**
* **Keeping kids in schools and businesses open.**
* **Funding our police and standing up for them when they needed it most.**
* **Standing up for a secure border by fighting the wave of illegal immigrants being dropped in our communities by a federal government that was asleep at the wheel.**

The list goes on. But the bottom line is that the left knows if they beat us in Florida, the message will be sent that GOP Governors better not try to lead for fear of a tsunami of liberal cash that will lie, cheat, and steal until they can kick real conservatives out of office.

**_No matter the cost, I have no intention of backing down._**

I hope you'll make a donation today so that we can keep up the fight. The liberal establishment is going to throw everything it can at us. **_[I hope you'll be there with me to fight back.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=01be4aabe2a04990aab40a34d05fd2d7&_e=2MbiMEemLrTAeyzb_xJYzN3-JTsfkuA-yrPXRXklORWxM5qyyPc1lDlotkxbJyZSF1hGy1SEgL4MSmIHwGTF75Zenfvt_7UVYieYsExBqg7_NZNKHYnKhiE_UBGRDqp5HHplzQv1V390sX-0XcvcDfJ7znlZip-PtfWXRFKJ54Nyd1Iosi8jT8RTLibz1x5gdpM2f_Z71mzmBPVHRopdQglSWPW2NqLfBOEebhd5h4BJnQ2ThajaJLiEwRrzQSRoUKQbzMhRugLQ-YjdePHyjB9XuFI-tzjg88gJQgzwLB018lMvt8Ga_BXg6zCku731__Fl_OwP1SisL7dp2NA8F_xTGChiiIfBFxd_oOgFGcFVgHsxocdT3iIasfHMOfuXu4O2zy09b1hYuGAdKvAUualmxzORF5BFs25PIXoWQ4g%3D "https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=6d0ad4f0c05f4616d56c5096773b9075c69310b5f7e05ce79be0aa257f034bcaa52e2b0dcca11b5f5787b19e8f1549d9dcdf4dce75ae5c66")_**

Sincerely,
Ron DeSantis

They want to choke off the ability of businesses they don't agree with from being able to buy and sell goods. That's not happening in Florida. I'm not letting Wall Street banks or credit card companies discriminate against people for any religious, political, or social beliefs. The reality is every time the economy is politicized, the end result is more market share for monopolistic legacy operators and crushing burdens on the small- and medium-sized business whose survival is critical to our communities and to our entrepreneurial spirit as a nation. This is as much an attack on the little guy and on the average consumer as it is an attack on conservatism. These reforms seem simple, right? Common sense. I think so, too. But it hasn't stopped the Left from attacking me. That's why I had to write you today. The Left has captured a lot of ground, and they've gotten many companies to agree to their demands, and with that complicity comes a great deal of money. The money being spent to stop what we're doing in Florida and to keep conservative victories like this from happening is immense. Every faceless liberal alphabet group you can think of, along with George Soros and Hollywood liberals, are spending money to defeat me while the legacy corporate media fabricates lies and half-truths to try and paint our successes - successes that look like common sense to average Americans - as the radical position. I have no doubt that the Left will spend MILLIONS trying to stop me from being re-elected. They want you and every other Republican and conservative in the country to sit down and shut up. To stop standing up for conservative principles. To stop advancing the cause of individual liberty. That's why I need your help. That's why I need you to donate today. We need to be able to fully fund the defense against the woke mob. Florida has led the way on some of the most critical issues to conservatives over the last few years. Fighting the Fauci fanatics. Keeping kids in schools and businesses open. Funding our police and standing up for them when they needed it most. Standing up for a secure border by fighting the wave of illegal immigrants being dropped in our communities by a federal government that was asleep at the wheel. The list goes on. But the bottom line is that the left knows if they beat us in Florida, the message will be sent that GOP Governors better not try to lead for fear of a tsunami of liberal cash that will lie, cheat, and steal until they can kick real conservatives out of office. No matter the cost, I have no intention of backing down. I hope you'll make a donation today so that we can keep up the fight. The liberal establishment is going to throw everything it can at us. "" Sincerely, Ron DeSantis "KEEP FLORIDA FREE" Paid by Ron DeSantis, Republican, for Governor Ron DeSantis for Governor | 301 W. Platt Street, Suite 345, Tampa, FL 33606 Don't want to receive any more of our emails? .

Peter,Today, Southern Minnesota has the opportunity to select a true fiscal conservative to fight back against inflation, Democrats, and this crippling recession in January.We face one of the worst economic prospects of the last 40 years. **Democrats are increasing taxes during a recession to pay for climate change, and socialized healthcare.** It is going to take a fierce fight to fix the damage Big Spenders have done to our economy.While in St Paul, I have been one of Minnesota’s strongest fiscal conservatives. **I don’t take money from lobbyists and special interest groups** , because when it is time to take hard votes I can’t be bought and paid for.Brad on the other hand, has taken hundreds of thousands from lobbyists and special interest groups. His Super PACs buy and pay for _squish Republicans_ willing to work “across the aisle.” _**Squish**_****_**Republicans**_**have “worked across the aisle” this year to help Democrats sign Gun Control, $700 Billion in new taxes, $250 Billion to the National Science Foundation, and tons of other Democrat priorities in the name of compromise.**
**Enough is Enough.** Conservatives are tired of electing bought and paid for _Squishes_ who cave at the first sign of pressure from the establishment.You know as your Congressman, I don’t cave. I never caved to leadership and their pressures in St Paul, and I won’t cave in Washington.I am not running a write-in campaign for the Special Election, but **on the front of your ballot - vote Munson.** You can find [your polling location](https://JeremyMunson.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ed4007ca3497aee312b2b63d0&id=25c583c48e&e=f4c2e54596) on the Secretary of State’s website to ensure you make it to the polls and elect a Fiscal Conservative Fighter to Congress this Fall.This recession is not going to be solved over night, but it can get worse. Every time _Squishes_ “compromise” with more spending and increasing the debt ceiling your groceries get more expensive. Our families cannot afford to let politicians spend more of our money on vanity projects.**You can be sure I will fight to end this recession, because I answer to Southern Minnesota and no one else.** Please call your friends, family, and co-workers and urge them to vote Munson. With your help, and Patriots on Team Munson across the district, we’ll send a message to the establishment that we’re tired of their excuses.
Jeremy Munson

body:
[1]Beto O'Rourke

I am feeling hopeful. Here's why:

1. Last Tuesday, Kansas overwhelmingly voted to keep abortion legal in
their state. It was a resounding victory for our pro-choice movement
and a clear sign that folks are ready to vote for reproductive freedom
in record numbers this November.

2. Beto recently stopped in Woodville, where the last candidate to
campaign for governor there was my mom, Ann Richards. In this
community with a population of 2,849 people, Beto ended up needing to
hold a second Drive for Texas town hall outside because everyone
couldn’t fit in the library.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220809-1.lg7vmH&refcode=ema20220809-202311&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=202311%2E444211%2EzIwHCY ]Photo from Beto townhall in Woodville

These two examples have filled my heart with hope this past
week. People of every
political background — Democrats, Republicans, Independents, and
first-time voters — are showing up and getting involved in this election
because they understand how high the stakes are.

This is just the beginning. People are ready to vote to protect our
reproductive rights and more. As my mom would say, I hear America singing.

But we cannot be naive about the massive political power we are up
against. Greg Abbott and GOP strategists are going to see the results in
Kansas as a warning sign, and a reason to launch even more attacks. He has
already committed to spending over $100 million against Beto before
Election Day, but we need to be prepared to see that number rise.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220809-1.lg7vmH&refcode=ema20220809-202311&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=202311%2E444211%2EzIwHCY ]As a proud member of this campaign, I'm asking you to donate anything
you can today to help us defeat Greg Abbott and elect Beto O'Rourke.
Beto's campaign is powered by people, so this couldn't be more important.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220809-1.lg7vmH&refcode=ema20220809-202311&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=202311%2E444211%2EzIwHCY ]Donate Now »

It's time for Texas to have a governor who listens to, works with, and
fights for the people of the state. And I believe with my whole heart that
if we come together and put everything we have, including some dollars,
into this fight — we will win.

We are the ones to meet this moment.

In solidarity,

Cecile

Cecile Richards
National Finance Chair, Beto for Texas
Former President of Planned Parenthood

name: Nikki Haley
subject: I’ve never lost a fight
body:
| | | [](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=03bf1a316ea64da4a20eee71c63009e4&_e=vdW9PfR0fc-qitYBKfhYAmLdDuc4SLUhZ1oAKRlG7BuYTgbUbs4JmJSs9fC1zhE6NRqUowza1jfuMwW9UXVFFr6QC1E89w50IoDosU63gdgju-ZEoLkG9R63DU053lXzyBTgvyDe9Afylqg4gcFeVozkgN2cuKSp2NouoDFa7YU_iRq4Km0zlOUYKIo0vr_jv7waOeFCXnn9smX36jKL79ziJaSovsAh0cZnPIMPBLCzC69LT7YUU5RzokKzjf2Q7SG34aD8Vc47EoT0W9S0v-T3dceiN0w1iLJWSpkGZC5FHBzRieKw36-KQ3_b41T4LUobmd8l5HL6qBQBB5Yvae96emdkMXFCf6_x4UCn7zAMLExhe6juWuVwdNzq3rQJGKFpf5fUJRtGSSTLYXXRYv63AhaWBR_pK-UFVMwtVBTQqecdYttHH8XOUXPhDxlA)

Friend,
---
I’ve never been one to back down when the going gets tough. When I see something wrong, I _have_ to say something or do something... even when everyone expects me to sit down and stay quiet. When I was elected to the state legislature, I discovered something alarming. Many important votes weren’t on record. If you wanted to see how your local representative voted on a bill, you couldn’t. There was no transparency. No accountability. **The more I looked into it, the more outrageous it was.** South Carolina was dead last in the country in terms of legislative voting transparency. The creation of whole new government agencies, tax exemptions, and regulations on buildings and businesses were becoming law without any accountability on the part of the lawmakers. I even watched members vote themselves retirement pay increases by voice vote — and then never have to admit to the voters what they did. **It was absurd. And it was time for a change.** So I took a stand. _I introduced legislation to make important votes in the legislature_** _on the record._**_ _ **It was a tough fight.** Most of my fellow legislators liked the status quo just fine. They tried to bully me into giving up, even taking away my committee positions.******[But that just made me want to fight harder. So I did.](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=03bf1a316ea64da4a20eee71c63009e4&_e=vdW9PfR0fc-qitYBKfhYAmLdDuc4SLUhZ1oAKRlG7BuYTgbUbs4JmJSs9fC1zhE6NRqUowza1jfuMwW9UXVFFr6QC1E89w50IoDosU63gdgju-ZEoLkG9R63DU053lXzyBTgvyDe9Afylqg4gcFeVozkgN2cuKSp2NouoDFa7YU_iRq4Km0zlOUYKIo0vr_jv7waOeFCXnn9smX36jKL7yhfHs2vF8AwjlvV2BSN5tPRmY_tZHNRiq_ieQ9s7t6_a1BlJTyD3u3FJUYLay7PtKXb0cS9WKiAr6SAQSKRS_DhOJhiYvmRH95kctgZuHcZwTESBaeRERh_u51BmIPHNo0wTQebOamkkNTHGiD_OOcEFCjGRJaIiB1jNc6nrIvokT8JoKzDS1pgrHhJXNVdqWgAiunvLoscE8GIznUVO8TeEbry_7raD8mm8drWz3Qv) ** I took the issue to the people. I made sure they knew the facts. For example, in 2008, only 8% of votes in the SC House were on the record for taxpayers to see. The people of my state were horrified, and they used the power of their voices to demand legislators support my bill. When I became governor, it was one of the first bills I signed into law. At the bill signing ceremony, I blasted Pat Benatar’s “Hit Me With Your Best Shot” from the capitol speakers. I hope my opponents got the message. **You can hit me with your best shot, but I’m going to keep fighting for what’s right. ** As we look to the November election, I know there will be tough fights. Democrats are already doing everything they can to attack and discredit Republicans. They’re willing to put it all on the line, and it’s up to us to fight fire with fire. When the Left launches attacks against strong conservatives, **we can’t back down**. We must keep fighting. **[That’s why I’m asking for your help. We need the funds to combat the Left and elect conservatives in key battleground races. As Pat Benatar says:](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=03bf1a316ea64da4a20eee71c63009e4&_e=vdW9PfR0fc-qitYBKfhYAmLdDuc4SLUhZ1oAKRlG7BuYTgbUbs4JmJSs9fC1zhE6NRqUowza1jfuMwW9UXVFFr6QC1E89w50IoDosU63gdgju-ZEoLkG9R63DU053lXzyBTgvyDe9Afylqg4gcFeVozkgN2cuKSp2NouoDFa7YU_iRq4Km0zlOUYKIo0vr_jv7waOeFCXnn9smX36jKL72SHZpCjbWo57z15QOZnMZED6l0JdwE2Vd4wClW0Bp03_BMz9UrrifDqKSpgZXGOhColFpqVkIs_m5dM8UjRkyvzVDNLVjwS-K4WP-nllCZkSujQrJNUQ28JfdzTb8lMo4LepMkf4SYmNwWV9QCdBZx_uEUGcWNVp98brOuV_ebt4TOrW1bsWegcTjhMy81zztuurj4es5QhZrp9QeylBnxijSEvFEhWmnEeIHw89YSU) ** **[“Knock me down, it's all in vain, I get right back up on my feet again!”](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=03bf1a316ea64da4a20eee71c63009e4&_e=vdW9PfR0fc-qitYBKfhYAmLdDuc4SLUhZ1oAKRlG7BuYTgbUbs4JmJSs9fC1zhE6NRqUowza1jfuMwW9UXVFFr6QC1E89w50IoDosU63gdgju-ZEoLkG9R63DU053lXzyBTgvyDe9Afylqg4gcFeVozkgN2cuKSp2NouoDFa7YU_iRq4Km0zlOUYKIo0vr_jv7waOeFCXnn9smX36jKL73KAFOrdTwzLzcCD8WOQrclL84vHhqbX923G0x5oniTQzMHXwWG_kpND6YC02J53v-utvHxflvcops3GGjiD6wuuKQR4DkwZYPaQxgHNXB3EqJjeaHatrhD6cTEutw9XopWhkwqUMY5TvE6VrUgIzzeHqmY8y1RUm-DupX17QHi0XcCEjRd6w8WQsE3IoP3HY_91u0Ga2KNYhT1rzD5yZFrbf0A7LvGPX1RqeBcy9Bze)** [**If you want to join me in building a coalition of conservatives and fighting the tough fights, pitch in a donation today.**](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=03bf1a316ea64da4a20eee71c63009e4&_e=vdW9PfR0fc-qitYBKfhYAmLdDuc4SLUhZ1oAKRlG7BuYTgbUbs4JmJSs9fC1zhE6NRqUowza1jfuMwW9UXVFFr6QC1E89w50IoDosU63gdgju-ZEoLkG9R63DU053lXzyBTgvyDe9Afylqg4gcFeVozkgN2cuKSp2NouoDFa7YU_iRq4Km0zlOUYKIo0vr_jv7waOeFCXnn9smX36jKL73y_IuxbzUN1n477_N8XCQC0XPfdUIFoMqZZYKqwdlX3hw_oAd_jGgxuWNiNk0bILbhEGkg8rREAfWH4z865QnQ16uJZUKZr82EcJYydhfItX1ZfIMzkZjcTsbWlDgz77htMKptT75JQ3HNQoNUDHOPTGAMiTPlUS6m-4YDrKAd0HWvsWrXTuaGPi_jbJjPgcXMZEF7Hd-bcsKZfjTDebJWvoCdQ_TbaNcHMQkvmBrfG) My very best,

clean_body: | | | Friend, I’ve never been one to back down when the going gets tough. When I see something wrong, I have to say something or do something... even when everyone expects me to sit down and stay quiet. When I was elected to the state legislature, I discovered something alarming. Many important votes weren’t on record. If you wanted to see how your local representative voted on a bill, you couldn’t. There was no transparency. No accountability. The more I looked into it, the more outrageous it was. South Carolina was dead last in the country in terms of legislative voting transparency. The creation of whole new government agencies, tax exemptions, and regulations on buildings and businesses were becoming law without any accountability on the part of the lawmakers. I even watched members vote themselves retirement pay increases by voice vote — and then never have to admit to the voters what they did. It was absurd. And it was time for a change. So I took a stand. I introduced legislation to make important votes in the legislature on the record. It was a tough fight. Most of my fellow legislators liked the status quo just fine. They tried to bully me into giving up, even taking away my committee positions.**** I took the issue to the people. I made sure they knew the facts. For example, in 2008, only 8% of votes in the SC House were on the record for taxpayers to see. The people of my state were horrified, and they used the power of their voices to demand legislators support my bill. When I became governor, it was one of the first bills I signed into law. At the bill signing ceremony, I blasted Pat Benatar’s “Hit Me With Your Best Shot” from the capitol speakers. I hope my opponents got the message. You can hit me with your best shot, but I’m going to keep fighting for what’s right. As we look to the November election, I know there will be tough fights. Democrats are already doing everything they can to attack and discredit Republicans. They’re willing to put it all on the line, and it’s up to us to fight fire with fire. When the Left launches attacks against strong conservatives, we can’t back down. We must keep fighting. My very best, Nikki Haley | DON’T MISS THIS UPDATE Did you know Nikki Haley recently endorsed a new slate of candidates for the upcoming midterm elections? # New projections have Lorinser within 2pts of defeating Bergman
_**According to a new analysis of two reputable political data organizations, Dr. Bob Lorinser is within two points of unseating incumbent Jack Bergman in the race for Michigan's 1st Congressional District.**_
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49006421/360438724/1277889215?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NDQwZDZhNy0xYjE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pZwZJtLMLSoQu1V_J-RsehNjRJNOMm_NaPxVL6UvXpg=)
_**Using the "Partisan Voting Index" by the Cook Report and new national data by Monmouth Polling, Lorinser is showing a massive swing in his chances to represent Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula in the House of Representatives.**_
TRAVERSE CITY, Mich. — In Dec. 2021, Cook Report's Partisan Voting Index (PVI) estimated that Republicans had a 13-point advantage in Michigan's 1st Congressional District (MI01).
National polling by Monmouth in January also showed that the public favored Republicans for party control of Congress by 7% (+7R).
However, the latest August PVI shows Republicans lost four points, bringing the baseline index to just a nine-point advantage for Republicans (+9R). Additionally, Monmouth Polling recently calculated a 14-point swing toward Democrats, creating a +7D national advantage. [The new PVI](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49006422/360438725/-1884017618?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NDQwZDZhNy0xYjE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pZwZJtLMLSoQu1V_J-RsehNjRJNOMm_NaPxVL6UvXpg=&emci=bb47283a-1918-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=7440d6a7-1b18-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427), in combination with Monmouth's latest poll, brings Lorinser within striking distance of overturning the seat.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49006423/360438726/1277889215?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NDQwZDZhNy0xYjE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pZwZJtLMLSoQu1V_J-RsehNjRJNOMm_NaPxVL6UvXpg=)"Given all of the new data, this is going to be a very tight race," said Dr. Lorinser. "We still have to earn those votes. Being within two points of victory gives us unprecedented momentum, but people are more than just pieces of data. We intend to continue campaigning with vigor."
Previous presidential elections determine Cook's outlook, comparing Northern Michigan / U.P. to district averages across the Nation. With a national 14-point swing for Democrats (now +7D), MI01 appears to be a dead heat.
Kevin Numerick, Dr. Lorinser's campaign manager, says although this projection does not directly compare the candidates to each other, the campaign is confident in the forecast.
"The information matches up with what we've seen on the ground," said Numerick. "With Jack's negative voting record and Dr. Bob's positive message focused on unity and support for working people, jobs, and healthcare access, especially reproductive freedom, we have a lot of support across party lines. Seeing more extensive data from outside sources is encouraging."
Lorinser's probable boost comes after the Supreme Court voted to overturn Roe v. Wade. Voters across both parties in Kansas came out in droves in opposition to a ballot referendum that would have restricted women's rights.
"As a family physician, I have a profound reverence for life, but I believe in a woman's right to choose," said Dr. Lorinser. "A doctor's office is far too small for a woman, her doctor, and the entire United States government.
"The SCOTUS ruling on Roe v. Wade is a tragedy for women across the Nation. I am motivated more than ever to get to Congress so I can be an advocate for individual liberty and reproductive freedom. I hope voters see the value of sending a compassionate family physician to the House. It will be a real advantage for our District and Nation.”
Monmouth is the only [A+ certified polling organization](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49006424/360438727/-480628328?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85Mjc5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3NDQwZDZhNy0xYjE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pZwZJtLMLSoQu1V_J-RsehNjRJNOMm_NaPxVL6UvXpg=&emci=bb47283a-1918-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=7440d6a7-1b18-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15167427) that has conducted national polling after the Kansas primary. Michigan has a similar ballot initiative that Monmouth data suggests will galvanize pro-choice voters.
"Watching my opponent's campaign, it's clear Bergman is also aware that the pendulum is shifting," said Dr. Lorinser. "To give voters a direct comparison, I hope he will soon find the courage to debate me."

Over the weekend, Lizzie was in Fort Bend, where she gave welcome remarks to the Texas Democratic Women (TDW) annual convention. It was great to be with members from across the state, including women from the new Fort Bend chapter, and thank them for their advocacy and hard work on behalf of Texas women.

In case you missed it: Lizzie appeared on MSNBC’s “Zerlina” show where she spoke with Maria Teresa Kumar about her bill to protect the right to travel out of state for abortion care.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220809wu?refcode=lpfe220809wu_m [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220809wu?refcode=lpfe220809wu_m]
“I introduced the bill because it’s happening here on the ground in Texas. Since last September, people have been leaving the state to obtain abortion care in other states where it remains legal. Now for Texans, the closest states are New Mexico and Kansas many hours away. What is truly frightening [is] of course not everyone can afford to travel... but now we have lawmakers here who are threatening people who travel out of state and threatening the people who help them.”
- Rep. Lizzie Fletcher

clean_body: [] Over the weekend, Lizzie was in Fort Bend, where she gave welcome remarks to the Texas Democratic Women (TDW) annual convention. It was great to be with members from across the state, including women from the new Fort Bend chapter, and thank them for their advocacy and hard work on behalf of Texas women. [] Lizzie was also glad to join the Indian American Political Action Committee for the Meet Your Elected Officials Reception at India House. [] [] In case you missed it: Lizzie appeared on MSNBC’s “Zerlina” show where she spoke with Maria Teresa Kumar about her bill to protect the right to travel out of state for abortion care. [] “I introduced the bill because it’s happening here on the ground in Texas. Since last September, people have been leaving the state to obtain abortion care in other states where it remains legal. Now for Texans, the closest states are New Mexico and Kansas many hours away. What is truly frightening [is] of course not everyone can afford to travel... but now we have lawmakers here who are threatening people who travel out of state and threatening the people who help them.” - Rep. | | | | | Peter, this is something else. **Last night it finally happened: The FBI raided Mar-a-Lago.** _We don't know yet exactly what they were looking for but apparently they opened Donald Trump's safe_, and rumors are he was keeping some classified documents illegally removed from Washington there. I'm sure we'll know more soon about which of Trump's many likely crimes led to the raid. Predictably, the Republican Party responded with their usual unhinged performative outrage, yet even worse as Donald Trump's their cult leader. Their _capo di tutti capi_ , in mob-speak. The seditionists came out screeching for shutting down the FBI, and then the secession talk started. **Among this collection of clods, crazy Kari Lake, the GOP nominee to be Governor of the key swing state of Arizona, even stuck out among the bunch:** Kari Lake is an insurrectionist who believes 10 year old girls who are raped are baby containers, wards of the state. Yet, criminals like Trump should be able to commit their crimes unmolested by the federal government, so long as they have the right politics. So now she's threatening the federal government, and all of us. body:
Today, President Biden signed the CHIPS and Science Act into law!
Peter - I have some very exciting news to share with you!

**Today, President Biden signed the CHIPS and Science Act, which includes a pilot version of the RECOMPETE Act that I introduced last year.**

The RECOMPETE Act is about ensuring people have economic opportunity - regardless of what zip code they live in. It will provide flexible, long-term grant assistance to help distressed communities create jobs and lay the foundation for long-term economic growth and opportunity.

Currently, 1/6 of the U.S. population lives in economically distressed communities, where workers are experiencing higher unemployment rates than the national average. Many of these communities are being left behind, lacking adequate economic opportunities.

When I first introduced the RECOMPETE Act, I was determined to provide underserved communities with the resources and help they need to create jobs. No community should have to worry that their main export will be young people.

**Peter****, this is a huge win for American families and communities - not just in Washington - but for folks all across the country.**

I remain committed to creating an economy that works for working people and ensuring all Americans have access to good-paying jobs. That's why, with you by my side, I've fought hard to get the RECOMPETE Act made into law. I'm proud to continue ensuring that folks all across our nation get the fair shot they're entitled to.

**[If you'd like to learn more about the RECOMPETE Act, you can read about it here! >> ](https://act.myngp.com/el/zyOPO0UtDPN6d9BHDX0JwWWbCwb-FaMUAdIl1bInGIs=/hPCmOLrjBA7mc-MGm_EgqCsBiqs3312IejsPevsG7F0=) **

There’s an opportunity for great change in Southwest Virginia. Any contribution you make will be split 50/50 with Taysha DeVaughan’s campaign to unseat Morgan Griffith and expose his record to the people of Southwest Virginia. **[Can we count on you to join the DPVA and Taysha DeVaughan and help us unseat Morgan Griffith?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49007917/360447717/-1474165131?refcode=220809&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlN2EzMjE0MC0yMDE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TInw4wPRB-gVpptuXfXv8P6PeUqGaZF4rCJ5jXbuSmo=)** Southwest Virginia is home to many of Virginia’s most beautiful vistas and communities. For the past decade it has been represented by Rep. Morgan Griffith – but this year, Morgan Griffith has a challenger. **[Can we count on your support in our push to unseat him?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49007918/360447718/-1474165131?refcode=220809&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlN2EzMjE0MC0yMDE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TInw4wPRB-gVpptuXfXv8P6PeUqGaZF4rCJ5jXbuSmo=)** During his time in office, Morgan Griffith has:
* Promoted Donald Trump’s baseless claims of election fraud in 2020, going so far as to vote to overturn the results of the 2020 presidential election
* Voted against bipartisan bill requiring background checks for firearm ownership
* Supported defunding Medicaid and made several attempts to dismantle the Affordable Care Act
* Voted against the PACT Act, preventing veterans who were exposed to toxic substances in the line of duty from receiving healthcare benefits

subject: A few words on what happened in the Senate

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

Senate Democrats passed a historic bill this weekend. It’s called the
Inflation Reduction Act and it will take major steps to invest in clean
energy, cut carbon emissions, tax corporations and the rich, and allow
Medicare to negotiate certain prescription drug prices.

And yet, it could’ve been better, but corporate Democrats like Manchin and
Sinema decided to block any improvements to the bill. Bernie Sanders
introduced amendments to extend the Child Tax Credit and expand Medicare
to cover vision, hearing, and dental for seniors. Only two Democrats voted
with Bernie on Medicare expansion, not a single Democrat voted with him
for the Child Tax Credit. Senator Warnock introduced an amendment to
expand Medicaid to millions of people. Bernie and only two other Democrats
voted for it.

This all happened while Senator Sinema voted with the GOP to protect
private equity firms from tax increases. What went on in the Senate is
exactly what happens when the most conservative, corporate-backed faction
wields power in the Democratic Party. The Inflation Reduction Act is a
policy victory, but it could’ve been so much more.

That’s why Justice Democrats is focused on electing BETTER Democrats, not
just the same corporate-backed Democrats. We’re re-electing the Squad —
AOC, Cori, Jamaal, Ilhan, Rashida, and Ayanna — and expanding the Squad by
adding Summer Lee and Greg Casar to our JD bloc in Congress.

While Democrats control the House, Senate, and the White House, we should
be expanding public health care programs like Medicare and Medicaid,
sending support to families with the Child Tax Credit, and so much more.

We will get significant wins in the Inflation Reduction Act, including
$369 billion towards clean energy and fighting climate change, a 40% cut
to carbon emissions by 2040, and lower energy and health care costs for
millions. But corporate Democrats allowed corporate lobbyists, and
Senators Manchin and Sinema to block this bill from including desperately

Democrats.

We will continue our work with the Squad and Bernie to advocate for
progressive policies. And we will continue to elect better Democrats so we
can transform the Democratic Party.

Friend,

Every few weeks, we select a subset of supporters to answer an important question:

What do you most want to see Veronica working on in Congress?

We’d like to get your most recent feedback – even if you’ve answered before – to make sure Veronica is fighting for your values.

Over the past few months, Veronica has proudly voted to pass historic infrastructure investments; stood up for reproductive rights against a partisan extremist Supreme Court; and continued to lead the fight for climate action, affordable health care, and immigration reform in Congress.

Veronica works so hard because she wants El Pasoans to have a strong voice for their values in Washington.

That's why we want to hear from you, friend.

Will you reply to this email with the top 3 policy areas that matter most to you? Our team will read and reply to as many responses as we can.

Last time we asked for your thoughts, Veronica loved reading your responses – and we can't wait to do it again.

Thank you, friend, for sharing your opinion. It's an honor to go to work every day to fight for you.

— Lauren Zimmerman
Campaign Manager, Team Veronica
Veronica Escobar made history as one of the first Texas Latinas elected to serve in Congress. She's an outspoken advocate for El Paso's progressive values in Washington. body:
Yesterday, I shared Bill Galvin’s long held anti-abortion stance which he affirmed in a debate held yesterday. He has repeatedly taken this position, saying to the Boston Globe in 2002: "As my record makes clear, I oppose abortion.” He voted even to ban abortion in cases of rape, incest, and to save the life of the mother. He believes abortion is “a personal decision.”
The problem is his personal belief has prevented him from seeking out ways the office of Secretary of State could protect those seeking and providing abortion care.
In 2022, this is a threat to our freedoms. I’m a woman, a Black woman, who understands how vitally important it is to protect this right...most importantly, I will fight to protect all of our civil rights.
This is what I’ve dedicated my life in service to do. And it’s what I will continue to do - yes, as Secretary of State. The job is more than pushing paper.
Please show your support with a donation today.

| | | BREAKING NEWS: Yesterday, the FBI raided Trump’s Mar-a-Lago home in Palm Beach, Florida as part of an investigation into the mishandling of classified documents. They even got into his safe – only time will tell what they found! 15 boxes of documents had already been confiscated from Mar-a-Lago that by law should have been turned over to the US National Archives at the end of Trump’s term in office. The Trump administration fundamentally failed to properly preserve troves of records from his disastrous presidential term, jeopardizing national security with their brazen disregard for the law. The Department of Justice must act immediately and charge Trump for stealing classified documents from White House! We can’t afford to waste any time – Trump and his cronies are FURIOUS about the FBI raid, and House Minority Leader Kevin McCarthy threatened to probe the DOJ if Republicans take back the House in November. Hello,
As a naval officer, my husband’s absence was a frequent expectation. The longest deployment was 13 months, another was around 10 months. These absences were expected for me as his spouse. I knew when I met him that he was committed to serve this nation to the best of his ability.
Those long deployments were less understandable for our children. For a ten-year-old, dad being gone from one summer to the next constituted a really long time – the first set of braces, Dad’s Day at school, a family’s worth of holidays, birthdays, and anniversaries...missing him in the photos.
It was always a joyous occasion when he returned from deployment. Often we’d want to surprise the kids, which led to a trove of heartfelt memories, some really precious. Once when Michael got home in the middle of the night, our toddler daughter exclaimed, “Mommy! Who is that sleeping in your bedroom?” For a toddler, 8 months is a near-lifetime.
I have no regrets being a military spouse, because our life was full of adventure to keep it fun, adversity to make us strong, and an acknowledgement that duty was served. Michael never complained, although I could see in his eyes how much he regretted the lost years that pictures will never fully capture. He tears up over not having been home to see either child take their first step.
Michael is now the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate against Chuck Grassley in Iowa. In taking this challenge on, he knows the commitment it’ll entail. But a commitment to service is what’s necessary for him to feel complete, to be the person he is. You see, he isn’t doing this because he wants to endure a nasty political campaign... he is running because he sees a duty to his fellow Iowans and this nation. He sees working in the Senate as a continuation of his many decades of service. Speak with him and you will quickly understand what drives him, where his heart is, and how well he relates with those struggling to make ends meet. In short, he gets it.
Of course, Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and their Super PACs are already starting to tell ridiculous, laughable lies about my husband. In one ad, they labeled Michael, a retired Vice Admiral, a radical socialist. Really? Good luck with that!
Michael doesn’t come from a political dynasty. No one in his family has ever been in politics. Like him, they are regular people, gifted with incredible work ethic and grounded in Iowa values.

It took an all-nighter to pass the Inflation Reduction Act and overcome Republican obstruction but, in the end, **Bob and Senate Democrats delivered results for the American people again.** Just take a look:
* Medicare can finally negotiate drug prices to control skyrocketing health care costs.
* Medicare Part D patients will have their out-of-pocket expenses capped at just $2,000 per year, with the option to make affordable monthly payments.
* Millions of people can continue to afford health care coverage thanks to the extension of tax credits granted through the Affordable Care Act. The average family of four, with a household income of $75,000, will save $248 a month.
* More people will find good-paying jobs in American manufacturing and clean energy.
* New incentives and investments will help reduce emissions by 40% by 2030 while lowering costs for our families.
* Coal miners that built our prosperity, but suffer from black lung disease, will continue to receive the benefits and care we owe them.

All of these victories are thanks to people like you, who invested in helping us deliver a Democratic majority in 2020. Now, we're asking you to expand that majority by chipping in.

It is past time that elected representatives in Washington, D.C. stand up against this abuse of power by using the constitutional power of Congress to hold these agencies accountable. name: Joe Kent
subject: My own ballot was rejected – and that’s not the worst of it. (see picture!)
body:
Dear Supporter,
Please see the attached screen shot showing that the Board of Elections rejected my own ballot.
Even worse, we've found hundreds of other people who voted for me who've also had their ballots rejected.
Right now my campaign is scrambling to notify all of these voters their ballots were rejected and get them to the election offices to cure their ballots so their votes will count - we're even offering to drive them if they need a ride.
With my opponent and I just a few hundred votes apart, can you please help us with a contribution to pay for this operation so we can make sure every vote counts? You can donate at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/kSPPiCNsKP7JEARerXatxg/EzRMhfGqGtf53ThbOIbmWQ).
So many of the people we've contacted are heartbroken and angry that their votes for me were not counted - I'm sure you would be, too. And the deadline for helping them resolve their ballots with the Board of Elections is just days away.
We're going door to door, making phone calls and sending texts to make sure none of our voters are disenfranchised, and this could be what makes the difference in this election. Please help us with this effort at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/Donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/kSPPiCNsKP7JEARerXatxg/EzRMhfGqGtf53ThbOIbmWQ).
Thank you for all your help.

Joe Kent

name: Delegate Jazz Lewis
subject: Help me support our students!
body:
Hi Folks,
Our students are this district's most precious and valuable asset. Investing in our students must always be our first priority. When we invest in our students, we invest in the future progress of our communities. In my career as a Delegate, I have worked with our schools to ensure students across Prince George’s County have the tools they need to be successful.
I encourage you to sponsor book bags and back-to-school items for the students of the 24th Legislative District. I am partnering with local non-profit organizations on several back to school community events, and with your help, we will be able to give students district-wide the necessary tools for learning. We will be connecting supporters with local 501c3 organizations, so we can ensure students arrive at our schools in the fall with their school supplies.
I look forward to the good work ahead,
Jazz

It doesn’t stop, Peter. SCOTUS announced that it will hear _Moore v. Harper_ , a case that threatens to end democracy as we know it. _And that’s not an exaggeration._ **Here’s what you need to know:** _Moore v. Harper_ could reinstate the extremely, illegally gerrymandered congressional maps that North Carolina’s highest court threw out. The Republicans aren’t just arguing that their awful maps were legal, they are arguing that our state Supreme Court had **NO** authority to strike them down. That means our state courts could lose power to strike down bad election laws passed by the legislature, and the Governor could lose power to veto them. It could even mean that state legislatures could seize the power to ignore the popular vote and send in their own slate of electors in the next presidential election. And if you think they wouldn’t do that, just listen to the January 6th Hearings. _This is beyond the pale!_ **[Peter, add your name now to our petition demanding that SCOTUS does its job and protect our rights and our democracy>>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49009957/360455989/1845665273?refcode=ea.54a64411-2918-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.54a64411-2918-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NGE2NDQxMS0yOTE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GbSYAEGxo7CIJz9NSq2CN3DC-D9RnmcLW0b73WqRbPk=&emci=2f65cab8-6417-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=54a64411-2918-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=1049176)** If the right-wing majority on SCOTUS sides with the North Carolina Republicans in this case:
* States could lose their ability to combat partisan gerrymandering
* Ballots could be thrown out for arbitrary reasons
* State courts could no longer protect our voting rights in federal elections
* States could pass laws that allow them to throw out the presidential electors chosen by the people and select their own

**In states like North Carolina with a GOP-controlled legislature, this would be a disaster.** Republican-controlled state legislatures could throw out the results of presidential elections they don’t like. It would give the Republican Party in these states _unlimited control_ over election laws. **[We cannot let this stand. We must act to make our voices heard. Sign our petition now to tell SCOTUS to defend our democracy instead of tearing it down>>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49009959/360455990/1845665273?refcode=ea.54a64411-2918-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ms=ea.54a64411-2918-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODE3NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1NGE2NDQxMS0yOTE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=GbSYAEGxo7CIJz9NSq2CN3DC-D9RnmcLW0b73WqRbPk=&emci=2f65cab8-6417-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=54a64411-2918-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=1049176)** Thank you for standing with me. | | Dear Friend, We’ve done something new.

We’ve created a free online teaching series that combines the learning of an online course with the features of a documentary.

That’s why when you watch the trailer for our newest free online teaching series, “**Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer** ,” you’ll notice that your professor, Dr. Laffer, is accompanied by Larry Kudlow, Steve Forbes, Amity Shlaes, and others. Together they explain the fascinating history of economics in America and what is required to restore economic freedom and prosperity to our great nation.

I’d like you to be one of the first people to preview this new series. **You can watch your video and pre-register for the new series below:**
---
| | [](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ec08414e930949aea6f243d7da321534&_e=9swtPrmzfkPr-1-do59SnwChFm8Xk1yaWCy5wkFh2ZqiEiAKMfShlwn12HHLJMFllN7npa8TQy8IPen-0QY36-EkWsHU-eF5Vp8YSR9XKtFjuNZ7vvoYF7iYBsFa2tcm5qfy5_Y7sD5jm_MDu0ZJ5A5yR_0zFnFMuogaGY-EOowplbLzWPPZTrGhkMcV_PzlP0PeMZqD6GLzt5hg5pRddpHfobP_LkwSIjPWhxelDydMWuqHZXnFIY2CBXiweViiKl6ky7h1IKnzQcSXBrE7H5LUQCSahE2yf08CGg1gK7wuKY4h4WGyptg1diAOAh43FJxHcZ5colkZSi8-QoHk04DeFohNz52XMFnVSkQ2UH8qRJ29qj0he9qr_pls_tFTVugNVU0D02t28OUhik8GBZQRA6exzzfvAOyy7GGYRaDynCQ4cwkCoFpJOEbxna4tEbLqaX0xKdvC8e0s-EI5r6IXFlt-tsCxYsWCsYxlPM8%3D)
---
In this free teaching series, Presidential Medal of Freedom recipient Arthur Laffer—famous for the Laffer Curve and for advising President Ronald Reagan—provides answers to fundamental questions about the core areas of macroeconomics—taxation, money, government spending, regulation, and trade—and how government policies in these areas either promote or hinder the growth of the economy.

In each episode, you’ll learn from Dr. Laffer, as well as:

* **Steve Forbes** , Chairman and Editor-in-Chief of Forbes Media.
* **Stephen Moore** , distinguished fellow in economics at the Heritage Foundation and author, with Art Laffer, of Trumponomics: Inside the America First Plan to Revive Our Economy.
* **Brian Domitrovic** , economic historian and author of Econoclasts: The Rebels Who Sparked the Supply-Side Revolution and Restored American Prosperity.
* **Larry Kudlow** , former Director of the National Economic Council under President Donald Trump.
* **Amity Shlaes** , chair of the board of the Calvin Coolidge Presidential Foundation and best-selling author of The Forgotten Man: A New History of the Great Depression.
* And, **Larry P. Arnn** , President of Hillsdale College.

This free series could not be timelier, given our current economic situation. In this free series, you’ll learn how private citizens drive the economy and you’ll discover the role economic incentives play in unleashing prosperity—timeless lessons in human nature and economics that are common sense to most Americans, but appear lost on many in our academic and political “elite.”

**[So, after watching the trailer, I hope you’ll be one of the first to join us by pre-registering for this free online series.](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ec08414e930949aea6f243d7da321534&_e=9swtPrmzfkPr-1-do59SnwChFm8Xk1yaWCy5wkFh2ZqiEiAKMfShlwn12HHLJMFllN7npa8TQy8IPen-0QY36-EkWsHU-eF5Vp8YSR9XKtFjuNZ7vvoYF7iYBsFa2tcm5qfy5_Y7sD5jm_MDu0ZJ5A5yR_0zFnFMuogaGY-EOowplbLzWPPZTrGhkMcV_PzlP0PeMZqD6GLzt5hg5pRddpHfobP_LkwSIjPWhxelDydMWuqHZXnFIY2CBXiweVii0mZMbwCNtT4L1ZKs0iOMM66ZP0Q75KD5veYDNwyd5nsQsA_YvPu284qLchJNBxCoC4PfVmbq3_Cd5UDMsMwaNya6fnDiBwyYRl6QBbsnq3A0mGEg3nJMs7u8zWzL0DJt5PSlMykWY77DAaR8aBEY2mL8ahKdtfPIeINeVjs5oENt1PA-9bwShPqP8OKvlnLqIVlILsatpm6F3khp_0BSiYaqPOgYgteqT_WnX_6uZmk%3D)**

Americans across the country like you are looking for answers to our current economic condition. But, as Dr. Art Laffer explains, good economic policy is not complicated, and you can learn why.

Pre-register for “**Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer** ” today!

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

**P.S.** There’s one more thing: After you pre-register, will you also consider giving a special tax-deductible gift to help promote “**Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer** ” to millions of Americans nationwide?

Your generous gift will help us promote this course and our other educational efforts, like _Imprimis_ and our classical K-12 education programs.

As you may know, Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding—even indirectly in the form of federal or state student loans and grants. That means this series and everything else we do here is only possible because of our generous supporters.

We’ve created a free online teaching series that combines the learning of an online course with the features of a documentary. That’s why when you watch the trailer for our newest free online teaching series, “Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer ,” you’ll notice that your professor, Dr. Laffer, is accompanied by Larry Kudlow, Steve Forbes, Amity Shlaes, and others. Together they explain the fascinating history of economics in America and what is required to restore economic freedom and prosperity to our great nation. I’d like you to be one of the first people to preview this new series. You can watch your video and pre-register for the new series below: | | In this free teaching series, Presidential Medal of Freedom recipient Arthur Laffer—famous for the Laffer Curve and for advising President Ronald Reagan—provides answers to fundamental questions about the core areas of macroeconomics—taxation, money, government spending, regulation, and trade—and how government policies in these areas either promote or hinder the growth of the economy. In each episode, you’ll learn from Dr. Laffer, as well as: Steve Forbes , Chairman and Editor-in-Chief of Forbes Media. Stephen Moore , distinguished fellow in economics at the Heritage Foundation and author, with Art Laffer, of Trumponomics: Inside the America First Plan to Revive Our Economy. Brian Domitrovic , economic historian and author of Econoclasts: The Rebels Who Sparked the Supply-Side Revolution and Restored American Prosperity. Larry Kudlow , former Director of the National Economic Council under President Donald Trump. Amity Shlaes , chair of the board of the Calvin Coolidge Presidential Foundation and best-selling author of The Forgotten Man: A New History of the Great Depression. And, Larry P. Arnn , President of Hillsdale College. This free series could not be timelier, given our current economic situation. In this free series, you’ll learn how private citizens drive the economy and you’ll discover the role economic incentives play in unleashing prosperity—timeless lessons in human nature and economics that are common sense to most Americans, but appear lost on many in our academic and political “elite.” Americans across the country like you are looking for answers to our current economic condition. But, as Dr. Art Laffer explains, good economic policy is not complicated, and you can learn why. Pre-register for “Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer ” today! There’s one more thing: After you pre-register, will you also consider giving a special tax-deductible gift to help promote “Supply-Side Economics and American Prosperity with Art Laffer ” to millions of Americans nationwide? ---

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49010343/360457745/1995090618?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYjY0MGI5Ni0yYjE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cK8Y-tM8XM6zqd7x6YFn48h1BK8zKuIRoLMEj4m_fQg=&emci=c51cc4a9-0a18-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=bb640b96-2b18-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4568237)

| | Derek, we did it. On Sunday, we passed the Inflation Reduction Act, a key part of Senate Democrats’ agenda on climate, deficit reduction, prescription drug prices, and inflation. It took months of hard work, but I never gave up hope that this moment was possible. I’m proud to have worked to get it across the finish line. The bill is now headed to the House, and we need to make sure my colleagues know how important it is to move fast. _[**Sign our petition now to urge the House to act quickly on the Inflation Reduction Act.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49010344/360457746/396430651?ms=mw_em_220809_1&refcode=mw_em_220809_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Manassas&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYjY0MGI5Ni0yYjE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cK8Y-tM8XM6zqd7x6YFn48h1BK8zKuIRoLMEj4m_fQg=&emci=c51cc4a9-0a18-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=bb640b96-2b18-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=4568237)_ Ask me what I like best about this bill and I don’t think I’d be able to answer you. In just one bill we’ve managed to:
* Cut the deficit by $300+ billion — a move that should help ease inflation.
* Make the most impactful investment in fighting climate change in our history. We’re going to cut emissions by a whopping 40%.
* Lower the cost of prescription drugs and health insurance premiums.

body:
The FBI and Department of Justice took completely unprecedented steps to invade the personal residence of a former President. | | | |
---
|
# **OFFICIAL STATEMENT ON THE RAIDING OF PRESIDENT TRUMP'S MAR-A-LAGO RESIDENCE **
---
| Yesterday was a dark stain on American history where we witnessed the FBI and Department of Justice take completely unprecedented steps to invade the personal residence of a former President. The American people deserve an immediate justification for such a drastic step to be taken. We have been offered no official statements, no press conference, not even a tweet from Merrick Garland's office, and this is absolutely egregious!

Given the recent history of political bias in these departments and the fact that they are currently under the jurisdiction of the opposition party, such unparalleled steps being taken without clear explanation requires a level of faith that these institutions have, quite frankly, not earned. In fact, the manner in which this occurred only raises more questions about their impartiality. These are the same agencies that publicly announced their investigation Hillary Clinton, but kicked in the door of the former President of the United States?
Regardless of one's feelings toward President Trump, this represents a potentially massive abuse of political power that is alarming on its face and takes our country down a terrifying path that may forever alter our nation. Incidents like this are more reminiscent of authoritarian regimes, where political opposition is persecuted for their stance against the status quo.

Accountability for yesterday's raid must be had! The warrant must be released to the public without delay. If this was an orchestrated political attack, those culpable need to be held accountable to the fullest extent of the law. As your next Congressman, I refuse to allow our government to become a tool of power for political gain and intimidation.

I will be praying for our country, and that cooler heads prevail in these trying times. Remember, our country is lost only when we stop fighting for the ideals that make the United States the beacon of freedom and prosperity for the rest of the world!

body:
From day one, we have been defined by people-power.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220809-3284-header&t=1&akid=3284%2E2526796%2EuC3AwM)
We’re exactly 90 days out from the 2022 midterms.
**And that means, in 90 days – Alexandria will officially be on the ballot for reelection.**
We can’t take anything for granted. Last year, Alexandria faced a $10 million challenge in the general election. This year, she has three opponents who have raised hundreds of thousands of dollars, and are going on cable news stoking fear about rising crime and calling Alexandria a “radical communist.”
**So we’re going to need your help to build the powerful momentum and organizing program we’ll need to keep Alexandria in Congress fighting for our communities.**
[Will you support AOC’s reelection right now in this key 90-day window? Your commitment will show Republicans and corporate Democrats alike that AOC is here to stay »](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220809.7zdfWB&refcode=em20220809-3284-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3284%2E2526796%2EuC3AwM)
**[Contribute to AOC’s re-election fund »](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220809.7zdfWB&refcode=em20220809-3284-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3284%2E2526796%2EuC3AwM)**
**From day one, we have been defined by people-power.** In 2018, we beat a machine with a movement. In 2020, we beat millions in corporate and special interest dollars with that same movement. And we’re going to do it again. How? By once again proving that people-power is winning power.
Across the country, people look towards our campaign as a vanguard of progressive change. Every person who supports Alexandria’s reelection isn’t just supporting her — **they’re supporting our movement and everything we’re fighting for.**
That has an impact. When other members of Congress or politicians see thousands of grassroots activists aligning themselves in support of Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and canceling student debt, it entices them to join our cause.
**But building a movement takes work. That’s why we’re asking you today to please chip if you’re able to – because when we all pitch in $3, $10, or $25, it adds up to something unstoppable.**
[So will you take a moment to lend us your grassroots support right now, and tell the entire nation that you stand with AOC?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220809.7zdfWB&refcode=em20220809-3284-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=3284%2E2526796%2EuC3AwM)
Thank you for everything.
Pa’lante,
Team AOC

name: Heidi St. John
subject: Thank you!
body:
Dear Peter,

When I announced that I was running for
Congress last year, my main goal was to make sure Jaime Herrera
Beutler would no longer represent Southwest Washington in the
next Congress. I knew we needed a change.

I was not alone in this. When all the votes
are counted, more than 85,000 across our district took a stand
and voted to make sure Jaime is no longer our Representative.
More than 35,000 will have voted for our campaign. We had an
excellent primary turnout and our message came through loud and
clear: We will no longer sit on the sidelines. To that, I say,
"Well done!"

As the results of last Tuesday's election
continue to come in, I want to say "thank you" from the bottom of
my heart. This is how campaigns are supposed to run: Ordinary
citizens linking arms to stand for freedom. And stand we did!
Your prayers, financial support and grassroots efforts enabled my
campaign to raise nearly $1.3 million and light a fire for
freedom across our great state.

I am especially grateful to the hundreds of
volunteers who waved signs, stuffed envelopes, made calls, walked
door-to-door, and prayed for the success of my campaign for the
last 18 months. To the more than 5,000 individuals from all 50
states who financially supported my campaign, I am truly humbled
by your generosity and encouragement.

On primary night more than 300 people
gathered with me. Over 75% of those in attendance raised their
hand when asked if this was the first time they had ever been
involved in a political campaign. That's exciting! Let's keep it
up. If we're to restore our country to the representative
Republic that our founding fathers intended, these "first timers"
must remain engaged.

You are the reason I ran for Congress. It
wasn't enough for me to tell you to "get off the bench" and make
a difference . . . I needed to put my words in action and
demonstrate how it's done. An ordinary citizen running for
Congress. That's honestly who we are and that's exactly what we
did. We left it all on the field for freedom.

My message of limited government, lower
taxes, less regulations, protections for our children, an end to
"wokeness" and a return to the Constitution resonated with tens
of thousands of voters, who honored me with their vote on August
2nd.

In the end, it was not enough to secure a
place in the top two-and now, we must focus our energy where it
can do the most good.

The Democrats have declared war on our
Constitutional Republic. With Socialist Democrats driving our
country over the cliff, I look forward to their historic losses
in November. When Republicans take over the Congress in 2023,
they cannot govern like they did when Paul Ryan was Speaker in
2017 and 2018. Anything short of a systematic dismantling of the
bureaucratic state will be considered a failure and unacceptable.

We must remove Pelosi from the speakership
which can only be done if we have a Republican majority in
Congress. I urge you to vote this November for the Republican
nominee.

We now have the same binary choice we had
between Clinton and Trump in 2016. The Democrats, showing they
care nothing for freedom, have put forth a Marxist in Marie
Perez. She must not be allowed to take this seat. It's true that
Joe Kent and I have some real differences on issues, but these
differences are nowhere near the differences between Joe Kent and
Marie Perez. These differences are not worth hurting our cause to
make a point.

Consider what's at stake: Besides being a
solid vote for Nancy Pelosi's America-killing agenda, Perez would
lock in decades of woke social policy, failed green energy
schemes, open borders, welfare and amnesty for all, higher taxes
on working families and more regulations on job creators.

Marie Perez is pro-abortion up to and
including the moment of birth, wants to ban most firearms and
have a government database of all the rest. There is little doubt
that she would champion her party's ideas for graphic sex lessons
to six-year-olds in every school in America.

It's time for Republicans to unite and defeat
both Patty Murray and Marie Perez with a straight ticket
Republican vote from top-to-bottom.

It's time to take our country back. We need
to set our differences aside and stand together as conservatives
to save America and stop Biden's dangerous radical-left Socialist
agenda, before it's too late.

To supporters who've inquired about my "next
steps," I am looking forward to serving over 1,700 students this
year at our Firmly Planted Family Homeschool Resource Center in
Vancouver. I also look forward to resuming my public speaking at
conferences around the country - something I love doing.

My organization, MomStrong International,
will continue to serve mothers and remind them of the value of
motherhood. We need this now more than ever. Of course, I'll keep
podcasting. Don't miss it!

Finally, nothing can dampen my resolve to do
what is right for this area. I have always wanted what was best
for SW Washington and I will continue to be a voice for freedom
in the days and months to come. Now is the time to stand
together. Only by uniting will we defeat the Democrats and take
our nation back from the brink of a leftist takeover.

My husband Jay and I, along with our children
and grandchildren are praying for God's blessing and protection
over our struggling nation.

I hope you will join me and support the
Republican vision for America and vote accordingly in November.
God bless you-and God bless the United States!

For Liberty and Southwest Washington,

Heidi St. John

Peter, it's Trudy's campaign manager, Alex. A week ago today, on the same night that Missouri Democrats chose Trudy as our nominee for Senate, **our neighbors in Kansas went to the polls and overwhelmingly, across party lines,_rejected_ a right-wing effort to remove abortion rights from their state constitution.**
Political insiders and right-wing strategists in Washington were shocked. **Their scheme to roll back reproductive rights was destroyed in a state that voted for Trump by more than 10 points just two years ago!** But honestly, to folks like me who grew up in this part of the country and who truly know the incredible communities here, this was no surprise.
Washington lobbyists and consultants think that places like my home state can’t be flipped blue. They think that voters won’t turn out at the polls when it counts. They think that the communities I know, which are full of so much love, will choose hatred and extremism over hope and unity. But, Peter, they are dead wrong.

On women's rights, Stitt takes extreme positions on decisions that should be up to a woman and her healthcare providers. He's put the government on the side of bounty hunters, rather than showing compassion and mercy for women facing difficult circumstances. On gun safety Stitt once again aligns with partisan extremists to politicize a public safety issue, and oppose common sense efforts to keep people safe, especially our kids in school.
