subject: This is what they’re up to
body:
| | | [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=452a92b852a544ec984152343eaf242c&_e=VS9hbtTbdkhszujTcCZGwNtFxXc1Qz4sL8rAgCfsB_Uj0OdkW5SnO4ybXNvIKSjur7fnRuq0O-b0LJPIcq74x7drHrRMjNT6kvWdYS76X4JYsoXgC3NZ9Akv4RuXTzRjlAnRlmA-PvB8CK-qtZbu-ymcnt2gH-1wOTgzmpeJoHf0FIav3O3G0hw0BCXfawqGID3rzpHncRd33vzskoFu5a990c3-UW-rk4etne0Loh_vSsiolX6o5LBLxyjAvQhJjAHLTImyddJOdHlBOtUwaxwXUdwzS13jVj3CVfEc1AUH2VZN7tW_LP5Di4ioYj3g0RK4X5uwKRDCTL867QKJXA%3D%3D)
---
Friend, The saying goes, if you're not paying for the product, you are the product.
Today, in Silicon Valley there is a group of tech oligarchs who view _you_ as _their_ product.
---
[](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=452a92b852a544ec984152343eaf242c&_e=VS9hbtTbdkhszujTcCZGwNtFxXc1Qz4sL8rAgCfsB_Uj0OdkW5SnO4ybXNvIKSjur7fnRuq0O-b0LJPIcq74x7drHrRMjNT6kvWdYS76X4JYsoXgC3NZ9Akv4RuXTzRj0zZ1i9TBY2ZgJHq38aVVNy2B9wZf-xyzAhYnQ0if1UWPEkEv4xsik7iXysK9QchUiCwKkg06mzRou6y7Nn6U_0S5MJWJ5mqj6HMrGlPAOAKQJbxTtOaEn0sx0OrEVW38c7Y49grYLSsMps8uTyZmGK_Ls0ocdpV5kFFaG2c0BStA_vvOra9Wibr91PmJy84ZQN6FwQt3v4qjs3YUVwK3bw%3D%3D)
---
**Your habits.**
**Your location.**
**Your purchases.**
**Your data.**
**Your attention.**
Those are the SKUs that make up the economy of _YOU_.
And they are happy to buy and sell every part of your life they can find a way to monetize. All the while they pretend they are the heroes because they gave the user something “free.”
I learned a long time ago, and I’m betting you did too, that there is no such thing as a “free” lunch. That’s clearly true when it comes to the attention merchants spewing forth from Silicon Valley.
For every email platform they give away, for the brand new smart device they subsidize your purchase of, for every new subscription service they offer what they are really doing is finding another way to get a little bit more of you, your friends, and your family into their inventory.
**I am fighting for the people of Florida, not the Big Tech oligarchs in San Fransisco.** **[We the People have the power to fight back. body:
Dear Friends,
This week is unprecedented. With the slimmest of Congressional majorities, the Democratic Party has delivered record results. From COVID relief, to jobs to infrastructure, to climate, to gun violence prevention, to health care, to veterans and military families:
Democrats delivered policy results that give leverage to working people over entrenched special interests.
And we need more.

name: Laura Loomer
subject: Who will Dismantle the FBI?
body:
Yesterday's FBI raid on the home of President Trump is an absolute outrage to every Conservative and any American who respects the Constitution! I was stunned by the news yesterday, and my hands are shaking as I write this.
****
| | | **[](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/OaH892CsKjr807634NocI0pqWg/AwtPWGg8cgwS4stBic3LVQ)**
Patriot,

[](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/OaH892CsKjr807634NocI0pqWg/AwtPWGg8cgwS4stBic3LVQ) Yesterday's FBI raid on the home of President Trump is an absolute outrage to every Conservative and any American who respects the Constitution!

I was stunned by the news yesterday, and my hands are shaking as I write this.

The Federal Bureau of Investigations is, was, and always has been the political enforcement arm for our government since it was created by J. Edgar Hoover. **THE FBI MUST BE DEFUNDED AND DISMANTLED!**

Any American who has a powerful enough voice to actually change government becomes a target of FBI surveillance and enforcement. Muhammad Ali, Martin Luther King, Ernest Hemingway, Journalist Mike Wallace, even Charlie Chapman and Albert Einstein were all investigated by the FBI.

Even I have been investigated and illegally red-flagged by the FBI and former FBI Director James Comey for my work as a conservative investigative journalist.

Now, the DHS, DOJ and the FBI are entirely inwardly focused and hell-bent on arresting Americans who were protesting at the Capitol on January 6th!

**And yesterday, they raided and occupied Mar-a-Lago, the home of President Trump, when unarmed, legal means of discovery could have been pursued through the courts!**

When I'm sworn into Congress, one of the **very first bills** I'll introduce will be to **DEFUND and DISMANTLE the FBI** to end the continued assault on Americans by this rogue agency that is now operating as the personal, Gestapo hit force for the Democrat Party and the illegitimate Biden Regime!

[Help me get to Congress to do that!](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/OaH892CsKjr807634NocI0pqWg/AwtPWGg8cgwS4stBic3LVQ)

**We have only two-weeks before the Florida Republican Primary, and early voting has already begun!**

My campaign funds are running short, and we have big purchases to make so we can reach voters in these last two critical weeks.

Please, [donate us much as you can today and help me win!](https://libersend.lauraloomerforcongress.com/l/jaHkxHkvgw3mMH3vyc0Hsw/OaH892CsKjr807634NocI0pqWg/AwtPWGg8cgwS4stBic3LVQ)

Thanks so much for all you do.

Respectfully,

Laura Loomer

# Erik Aadland Joined Commitment To Colorado Republican Press Conference
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
(August 9, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, participated in the Commitment to Colorado Republican press conference alongside other candidates for Colorado state and federal offices.
Led by Kristi Burton Brown, Colorado Republican Party Chair, this talented group included candidates for U.S. Senate, Governor, U.S. Congress, Attorney general, Treasurer, State Board of Education, and Secretary of State.
The Republicans are unified on the need to retake Congress and win offices here in Colorado, to counter the failed policies and actions of President Biden and the U.S. Congress both of which are out of touch with the American people.
"We are dedicated to getting Congress to adhere to its Constitutional mandate and to defeat the radical Colorado Democrats this fall," said Aadland. "We can make this a clean sweep and that is what it will take to turn the tide on the President's far left agenda. Winning back Congress will provide a check on an out-of-control, Nancy Pelosi and Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez-led House and leftists in the U.S. Senate which is bolstered by the tie-breaking ability of Vice-President Kamala Harris."
The candidates discussed a wide range of issues and agreed that conservative policies are required to return the economy, and specifically inflation, to the level experienced just a year and a half ago.
Crime is a major concern, and it was recognized that the current spike in crime is largely due to radical politicians enacting soft-on-crime legislation and district attorneys who fail to enforce the law.
Candidates also acknowledged that education requires an overhaul, as teacher union bosses and radicals have taken control of schools. Candidates believe that the role of parents in schools should be restored and the school curricula must reflect the needs of the nation.

body:
We deserve something new

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-aug-2022?refcode=809womangov [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-aug-2022?refcode=809womangov]
Dear Peter,
Like so many of you, I know what it’s like to be underestimated.
For my entire life, I’ve stood up and fought for change. And for my entire life, I’ve faced doubt, skepticism, and straight up misogyny. From my tenure as the first Jewish woman student body president at the University of Florida to my service as a public defender and the Commissioner of Agriculture, I’ve been told that I shouldn’t bother — that I couldn’t do it.
But for centuries, women have never given up in their fight for change. Instead, they kept pushing forward — overcoming any obstacle and proving the skeptics wrong. And those women are the reason we are where we are today.
These women and their legacies have only strengthened my resolve to stand up for Florida women, win this race, and give Floridians their first ever woman Governor — no matter how many people say it can’t be done.
I’ve never been afraid to ruffle feathers, Peter. And I’m ready to ruffle as many feathers as it takes to bring something new to our state — to deliver real, meaningful change for Floridians. If you’re with me, click here to chip in $20 and help elect Florida’s first woman Governor. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-aug-2022?refcode=809womangov]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will be processed immediately.

With Roe overturned and DeSantis’ 15-week abortion ban in effect, there’s no denying that women are under attack in our state and in our country.
But no matter how hard DeSantis and his GOP allies try to drag us back to a time when women were expected to be seen and not heard, I’ll never stop fighting to amplify women’s voices and make sure we have a say on the issues that impact us most.
Florida women deserve a champion — someone who has never and will never waver in the fight for women’s rights. I’m ready to be that champion. Stand with me in my fight to end DeSantis’ dictatorship and give women a powerful voice in the Governor’s office. Click here to make a donation today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-aug-2022?refcode=809womangov]
Thank you for standing with me.
— Nikki

| | | | | Peter, Let me be blunt: [Please subscribe to my rapidly growing Youtube Channel](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8e9a7912-a299-48e1-ac93-649a90d01649/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), **_[The Takedown w Cliff Schecter](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tde368d2c-08a7-4049-a2a8-141627f3b311/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)_** , where we expose the insanity of Republican representatives and policy every day, often many times a day. We just witnessd the FBI raiding Donald Trump's home at Mar-a-Lago. That is insane! And, yet, this is where we are today. Much of this this will play out, and I will discuss it all and more at [The Takedown](https://default.salsalabs.org/T18167d64-fc86-4269-991e-da1776c91416/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). But at times like this in history, we must all do more, whatever we can. The channel is growing rapidly, and the quicker it grows, the more Youtube recommends it, and then we may have something on our hands that can really influence our politics in a positive way. The only cost is a minute or two of your time. Then you can watch the videos and if you enjoy them, and think, as I do, that they can and will make a difference, like them, comment on them and share them. Especially with friends, family and colleagues who need some convincing that _we are right about the danger posed by the Republican Party,_ or, as importantly, _that they use their right as an American citizen to turnout and vote for a better tomorrow_. We can only do this if we're all, all in. I know am. And I'm quite sure you are too. So before wishing you a good Friday evening, and a great weekend, I'll just ask you one more time if you'd please subscribe to [The Takedown w/ Cliff Schecter](https://default.salsalabs.org/T027b5788-6ea5-4bbb-bab3-40220ef0714d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). Please have a wonderful night and a fantastic weekend, as we recharge our batteries for next week. All my best, Cliff

body:
hint: it's because he's not in Pennsylvania | | | Hi Peter, it’s John Fetterman. I hope you’ve been having a safe + fun summer with your friends + loved ones. Though our summer is costing a *lot* more than it did last year and is much hotter than last year, the Fetterman Fam is having a great summer right here in Braddock, PA. 😎 Dr. Oz, on the other hand, can’t say the same. I mean, he spent the 4th of July partying it up at a gala in New York, surrounded by celebrities like Ryan Seacrest and Kendall Jenner. **He's able to beat the Pennsylvania heat, and heat all across rural America, by not living in rural America.** I dare this dude to stay in Pennsylvania for like, one day. 🙄 It’s an icky reminder that ultra-rich GOP Dr. Oz doesn't even have to worry about raising money for his campaign. He’s already self-funding his campaign, plus he has essentially unlimited access to other celebrities + millionaires. **Meanwhile, all summer long, with this heatwave, we've seen a massive slowdown in online fundraising, since our donors (aka real people like you, Peter) are rightfully spending time outside in the sun with loved ones.** Don’t get me wrong. Our campaign is PROUDLY bought + paid for by the people, and we’d never have it any other way. But with the stakes this high, I can’t afford to fall behind Dr. Oz in PA. clean_body: hint: it's because he's not in Pennsylvania | | | Hi Peter, it’s John Fetterman. I hope you’ve been having a safe + fun summer with your friends + loved ones. Though our summer is costing a lot more than it did last year and is much hotter than last year, the Fetterman Fam is having a great summer right here in Braddock, PA. 😎 Dr. Oz, on the other hand, can’t say the same. I mean, he spent the 4th of July partying it up at a gala in New York, surrounded by celebrities like Ryan Seacrest and Kendall Jenner. He's able to beat the Pennsylvania heat, and heat all across rural America, by not living in rural America. I dare this dude to stay in Pennsylvania for like, one day. 🙄 It’s an icky reminder that ultra-rich GOP Dr. Oz doesn't even have to worry about raising money for his campaign. He’s already self-funding his campaign, plus he has essentially unlimited access to other celebrities + millionaires. Meanwhile, all summer long, with this heatwave, we've seen a massive slowdown in online fundraising, since our donors (aka real people like you, Peter) are rightfully spending time outside in the sun with loved ones. Don’t get me wrong. Our campaign is PROUDLY bought + paid for by the people, and we’d never have it any other way. But with the stakes this high, I can’t afford to fall behind Dr. Oz in PA. And United Rural Democrats can’t afford to fall behind their fundraising goals to elect Democrats across the Midwest, either. If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately: Doc Hollywood can have his star-studded parties and weekends in the Hamptons. My priorities just look a little different. 😁 Thanks for your help, John Fetterman Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania United Rural Democrats (URD) is leading the effort to rebuild the Democratic Party in rural America. If we're going to take back our country, we need a 50-state strategy to organize in every community across the country. Will you support our network of activists on the ground as we work to rebuild our party's infrastructure and flip these areas blue?

---

---
---
| | | Dear Peter,

Farming is the backbone of our district and our country. I will always celebrate the American farmer, their work ethic, and the quality products they bring into our homes.

However, it’s hard for the American farmer to celebrate these days, as they’re facing more challenges than ever. From trade and market access, rising input costs, and supply chain issues, to concerns over rural broadband and aging transportation infrastructure, today’s farmers need an advocate in Washington who will address their concerns and work to make their jobs easier.

[That's why I am reaching out today to build my agriculture coalition; comprised of farmers, agribusiness leaders, and industry experts.](https://regan4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=e1c80bc180&e=2fa613cb76) I need a strong coalition behind me who will stand up against the record high inflation under the Biden Administration (that Nikki Budzinski was a part of until just a year ago).

Their disastrous administration is taking our country back on a freight train in the wrong direction. Today’s inflation numbers hit a historic 41-year record high. Illinois farmers remember 41 years ago - the beginning of the worst farm economy since the Great Depression. Illinois farmers know Nikki is bad for business. That's why I am asking you today to join my Ag coalition team. [Sign up here:](https://regan4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=62755cae87ea324590220f153&id=c411b2e682&e=2fa613cb76)

I won’t lie: When I think about all the terrible things Ron DeSantis has done to Florida and her people during his time as governor, my blood pressure rises. It seems there’s _no end_ to what he’ll do to advance his political career.

He signed the **most restrictive anti-choice legislation** in Florida’s history since _Roe v. Wade_ , with no exceptions for horrible situations like rape or incest. It’s a monstrous law, but it won him points with presidential Republican primary voters, so he supports it.

Then, **he suspended a democratically elected state sttorney** because the attorney dared to stand up to Ron’s unconstitutional abortion ban.

He’s vowed to **eliminate background checks and gun permits** across Florida, putting our children and our families in greater danger.

DeSantis signed legislation **targeting LGBTQ+ kids in the classroom** , further marginalizing already vulnerable students. We should be nurturing _all_ of Florida’s future leaders, not tormenting them for political gain.

He’s determined to silence _anyone_ who opposes him. One autocracy expert recently claimed in _Politico_ that **DeSantis is trying to turn Florida into his own personal “mini-autocracy.”** He’s even created an “elections police” unit that people fear will be more about voter intimidation than voter protection.

And now he’s **banning math textbooks!** Sadly, you can’t make this stuff up.

Suffice to say, the stakes could not be higher in this November’s election. With DeSantis eyeing a run for president in 2024, there’s no telling what he’d do with a second term as governor if he thought it would help him get to the White House.

**The good news: a recent _Listener Group_ poll shows me outright BEATING the governor in November. But I’ll need your help to maintain that lead and get Florida back on the right track. Will you pitch in right now to help keep up the momentum?**

********I 'm at my wits' end, Peter. Pelosi and the Democrats just have too much power, too many connections, and too much in their fundraising war chest. At this point, if I don't do a total 180 on the fundraising front, not only will I have to possibly SHUT DOWN my campaign, **_but Republicans may never win another race this year._** **Peter, this is Ryan Zinke. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49014575/360476942/-1862136002?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcyMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMWM4OGMxYi00MDE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XPVCq241LvPXEv520ui2vmBpAvI1wJMqsn1BB5qb-Ck=&emci=33f9a2d1-2418-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&emdi=c1c88c1b-4018-ed11-bd6e-281878b83d8a&ceid=15384964)
Peter,

If passed by the House, this bill would make historic investments in lowering health care costs, fighting climate change, and closing tax loopholes that benefit only the wealthiest corporations.

body:

Peter,

Workers’ rights are under attack in Tennessee. Corporate special interest groups and big business are trying to enshrine Tennessee’s “Right to Work” law in the state constitution, and the Republican Party is paving the way.

This unnecessary constitutional amendment would make workplaces more dangerous, lock a generation of Tennesseans into low-wage jobs, and set a dangerous precedent of allowing politicians to amend the constitution for their own personal agenda. We need every Tennessean to VOTE NO on Amendment 1 this November.

That’s why we teamed up with the AFL-CIO for a project highlighting how actual union workers feel about this amendment and how it would affect all workers. Here’s Michael Miller, member of the United Auto Workers, talking about why you should VOTE NO on Amendment 1.

https://youtu.be/6YgDlEDfx9I [https://youtu.be/6YgDlEDfx9I]

Will you help us stop Amendment 1 on November 8th by voting NO?

We can stop it if we all stand together. There’s power in organizing, whether it be in the workplace or in politics, and that’s exactly what we plan to do — organize, organize, organize until we win.
And remember, VOTE NO on Amendment 1 in November!

In Solidarity,

TNDP Staff Union

subject: We need to make sure every voter knows where Ted Budd stands on abortion:
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
Last Tuesday’s major victory for abortion rights in Kansas proved that the naysayers and pundits were wrong.

Last Tuesday’s major victory for abortion rights in Kansas proved that the naysayers and pundits were wrong. We cannot and should not be afraid to talk about the stakes for abortion rights in November.
Cheri Beasley will cast the decisive 51st vote to protect abortion rights in the Senate and roll back the slew of outright bans we’ve seen from state legislatures across the nation.
Meanwhile, our opponent cannot hide his extreme, out-of-touch position calling for a complete ban nationwide without exceptions. But it’s our job to make sure every voter knows exactly where Ted Budd stands.
[**Please make a donation to Cheri Beasley’s campaign for U.S. Senate today. It’s going to take every single one of us to flip this seat and expand our majority, but this is our best chance to end Washington’s gridlock and deliver meaningful progress for our families.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220809-2-subs&t=1&akid=1421%2E357359%2EaovmZn)
**[DONATE](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220809-2-subs&t=2&akid=1421%2E357359%2EaovmZn)**
* * *
#
Earlier this week, abortion rights were on the ballot in Kansas, and the answer from voters was resoundingly in favor of the right to abortion. Nearly 60 percent of voters in Kansas voted in favor of keeping their state constitution’s protections for abortion.
For years, pundits in Washington told us abortion rights were not a winning issue at the ballot box. It’s a big reason why reproductive freedom was never a priority in Congress, and now today, abortion has been completely or nearly banned in dozens of states.
Republicans like our opponent Ted Budd got exactly what they wanted when the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , and next they want to pass a national abortion ban without exceptions.
The contrast could not be clearer: Elect Cheri Beasley and secure the decisive 51st vote to protect abortion rights once and for all, or elect Ted Budd and give Republicans another vote for a national abortion ban in the Senate.
It’s up to us to make sure we have the resources to make the stakes in November clear to voters. If we do that, we win and expand our majority. But we need your help:
[**Can you please make a $3 donation to ensure Cheri has the resources to reach every single voter necessary to win in November? It’s important that every voter knows exactly what’s on the line in North Carolina.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220809-2-subs&t=3&akid=1421%2E357359%2EaovmZn)
**[DONATE](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220809-2-subs&t=4&akid=1421%2E357359%2EaovmZn)**
The pundits who spent years questioning whether abortion rights were a winning issue electorally are the same ones who are trying to say that Democrats have no chance this fall. They say history is against us, and there’s nothing we can do.
That’s utter nonsense, and we know it. The Republicans’ agenda is more extreme than ever, and their politicized Supreme Court is threatening so many of our fundamental rights and freedoms.
We absolutely can win. So let’s go prove them wrong and defy history with Cheri Beasley.
[**Make a $3 donation right now to flip North Carolina’s Senate seat. This is one of the most winnable races in the country, but it is going to take all of us.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-aug22.dwKUnu&refcode=em220809-2-subs&t=5&akid=1421%2E357359%2EaovmZn)

At VoteWater, you can bet they are fighting tooth and nail for the latter of those two options. There is only one candidate in this primary race that can be trusted to champion this cause, and VoteWater knows that it is Ken Russell. Ken's opponent has voted for Big Sugar’s interest and has accepted campaign contributions from Big Sugar. She cannot be trusted to make the right decisions regarding clean water. VoteWater is throwing its full support behind Ken, and you should too. South Florida deserves someone who won’t sell out our futures to the highest bidder. We need Ken Russell. body:
| | | Dear Fellow American, As a leader in the pro-life movement, I’m urgently reaching out to folks like you who believe in life, liberty, and the rule of law to join me in a special mission. [**Will you help me hold accountable members of the radical anarchist pro-abortion group “Reproductive Justice Union” for their attacks on my family and other pro-life advocates?** ](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=96912bac8f774de481fe9811b0e24b8b&_e=EPxUsF8iUgRuMPPqPmTpfXVK2P_hvRTVl3xeLuOsdcxLCvJI6yG_4xrPTNupbnXezd3YQxW-SvEdlIy5wWRmVuSttuNqDYCP7BTVmdjJWVd5MvJThCZ3Qp-LnzmclUioOxztjIycoQtESHP2nnvMez1SCMdJ1mgV17KDFDKRzJWk7ir9aQr-h0MTWmzh4z7SVChUILa2445MnZjmzD7x5wHcJED5a3Awl85QSTQdRHVztTUVtnISr6XVJiZILWr-h3BZTsETJWJLjuhXjrgTDsD5QnZYbGFAurzylsOeyJ6_K-FH1f4stM2pDDJZQK86REidOd0ZK1uI_HQo148c8iB9k7wrzpcWlxkZsGypJtaT4G1zMEsmN8fbeSsLufW68br4KJVXeQ9TX1xtKqVNyEWcjae77_NCaZECgf-3gcw%3D) Please, allow me to explain... My name is Tom Brejcha and I’m the president and founder of the Thomas More Society, a non-profit law firm dedicated to defending life, family, religious liberty, and election integrity. Perhaps you recognize my name from our work representing David Daleiden in his high-profile court battles with Planned Parenthood, the National Abortion Federation, and the state of California. In the days following the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade,_ “Reproductive Justice Union” made credible threats against me on Twitter. clean_body: Extreme right-wing gerrymandering is unacceptable – we must fight to ensure the equality of all votes and all voices in Ohio. = “Maps in Four States Were Ruled Illegal Gerrymanders. They’re Being Used Anyway.” - The New York Times, 8/8/22 Team – Not once, not twice, but several times just since the last election, Republican-drawn maps for both congressional districts and the state House and Senate have been thrown out and ruled to be in violation of the constitution by the Ohio Supreme Court due to gerrymandering. Here’s why that’s such a problem: When Republicans force through gerrymandered maps, we end up with the opposite of a democracy – we end up with a government that doesn’t represent the voices of most Ohioans, and instead represents the wishes of right-wing leaders who control the levers of power. = This isn’t an abstract issue. Over and over, in states across the country including Ohio, the GOP has deliberately chosen to move forward with districts that were proven to be illegal, undemocratic gerrymanders. It’s why voters in Ohio had to vote in two primary elections this year rather than one when Republican lawmakers failed to submit maps that complied with the state constitution – to the tune of millions of dollars in taxpayer money, and a lot of confusion for voters. Every vote should carry equal weight in determining representation, but thanks to gerrymandering, Republicans are rigging our political system to their own advantage. The Ohio Governor sits on the Ohio Redistricting Commission. Ohio voters deserve a governor who will stick up for fair representation in the map-drawing process. body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

Stacey Abrams will deliver a major address in a few short hours to share
her vision for Georgia’s economic future. Before she takes the stage, we
need to raise $20,000 to ensure we have the resources to spread her
message to voters across the state.

Hitting our goal will show everyone just how excited
people are for an
economic future where we do so much more than survive — one where Georgia
thrives.

We can hit our $20,000 goal, but we’re going to need all hands on deck.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1675?refcode=sa_em_220809_B2_BeforeStage_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&t=1002&akid=1383%2E1862389%2E5n0Qi3 ]We hope we can count on you,
Derek. Will you help us hit our
goal with a $5 contribution before Stacey takes the stage
at 6:30pm tonight?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1675?refcode=sa_em_220809_B2_BeforeStage_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&t=1003&akid=1383%2E1862389%2E5n0Qi3 ]DONATE

Please understand: we’re not making up the $20,000 number — it is
precisely what we need to share Stacey’s economic message with voters in
every corner of Georgia.

And if you are able to make a donation of $5 or any amount
right now, you’ll make a real difference in ensuring we hit today’s goal.

You’ll hear more from Stacey herself soon, on how we can transform Georgia
and begin our next greatest chapter. Before then, can you join our fight
to ensure every Georgian has an abundance of opportunities, not just to
survive but to thrive?

We’re counting on grassroots
supporters like you
to make clear that we have what it takes to win, before Stacey delivers
her critical speech tonight.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1675?refcode=sa_em_220809_B2_BeforeStage_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&t=1004&akid=1383%2E1862389%2E5n0Qi3 ]Please, will you make your
first contribution
right now and help hit our $20,000 goal? Anything you can invest in the
next few hours will make a real difference to our grassroots campaign.

Derek,
let’s do this together.

Stacey Abrams HQ

P.S. You can tune in to watch as Stacey addresses the state of the economy
and how Georgia will thrive when she becomes governor tonight at 6:30pm ET

Good Afternoon, Peter, I have one simple question for you, but I want you to think long and hard about your answer because it may determine where we go as a nation.

**What does America mean to you, Peter?**
---
[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=3e0316c2f17143788eb4b85ef4721a58&_e=4KnQoN-GavU0TM66QeGHZN0lbSL8R2tVUjq6sNISTRjKV4aobTmjdV5MXVSUc4kt4IgEXtRvuYaVHViC50Mgl8CJvFKRpalnTSOe5fZ90FwRazrHaQnC7Niy4KtVpClLxYIQqOVrRRZDesAWbCXSK5-llkATDfxSa1Lxo6Jb7YEzOm_WcQyueaxeUfFBJjGXur5DeLRCxzwc8BlqsvdDGzVI43_Xvqpv9tiP0daxIgl2BY3q2FsDL9KhmKN2USGZ824C8YXr53q2fmEidMUJdlmF3aSeR5SdeYoeJfnf2Cii0pmt2fTysCV2Ejj_X2AvrKACt_euH-2eOyvv7Uy_62pTtyYKlcnHSsGzvYdbNBhqNZNSMhG3unfhRqrWxWIIa9M9KrbZQ_poj9hub3yfOg%3D%3D)

[**STAND WITH HUNG CAO FOR CONGRESS**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=3e0316c2f17143788eb4b85ef4721a58&_e=4KnQoN-GavU0TM66QeGHZN0lbSL8R2tVUjq6sNISTRjKV4aobTmjdV5MXVSUc4kt4IgEXtRvuYaVHViC50Mgl8CJvFKRpalnTSOe5fZ90FwRazrHaQnC7Niy4KtVpClLxYIQqOVrRRZDesAWbCXSK5-llkATDfxSa1Lxo6Jb7YEzOm_WcQyueaxeUfFBJjGXiWp_bWrolAX7of-ctAgj9iqZrs7gFukN__trvbweJfIKaZXqrPjG3YeroF32ND5Z-sjGuGhIKIa5VtoXFpzrOgKXwpwKQobKNjtn92YmgUzw7-d7Q0JZyiaSNxRU0wrM9IBq5_zix4EvTnU0AKtAAjb7e4QxgOgiyKLuecULeNyyMjDUyvBN0x0Cvu_9Glr-tRu5ayr6dMtZo8YqY8Dr9w%3D%3D)
---
To me and my family, America means hope, freedom, and the promise of a better tomorrow. This nation took my family in when we were refugees escaping tyranny and death during the fall of Saigon.

_**This is my home, and it has given my family so much.**_ That’s exactly why I joined the U.S. Military and served as an Explosive Ordinance Disposal (EOD) Officer while fighting in Afghanistan and Iraq.

I put my life on the line for this nation, and I would gladly do it again in a heartbeat. | Peter, there’s been a lot of talk about how this race is going to be a tough one for us to win.

But here’s what I want you to know: I’ve been in tough races before — and I’ve never lost because I’ve always had a strong team on my side. [_**Can you contribute to our campaign and to Fight for Progress so we can keep our momentum going?**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/49010629/360459182/1150881829?refcode=BLU-FFP-20220809-2-EM&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImY2MDExOWQ5LTJkMTgtZWQxMS1iZDZlLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=R_UR_d4KcwYYgHuSlGb8NqwEfvQs4b95Osz8N_jaE-E=)

**2004:** I won my State Representative race in a Republican district as a Democrat. I knocked on 18,000 doors and wore out two pairs of shoes in the process. I won re-election in my district for three more terms, too.

**2011:** I ran for the Montgomery County Board of Commissioners and won — marking the first time in history that Republicans lost control of the Board of Commissioners and the first time Democrats controlled the Board since the Civil War.

**2016:** I ran for Pennsylvania Attorney General and won with 51% of the vote — at the same time Donald Trump won Pennsylvania, too.

**2020:** I ran for re-election as the People’s Attorney General — and received more votes than any candidate in Pennsylvania history.

Let me be clear: We need to win this time too because our rights and our freedoms are on the line. I’ve only won races because I’ve had supporters on my side — which is why I'm going to need your help to do this. Friend, I was deeply relieved last week when Kansas voters struck down a proposed amendment to their constitution that would ban abortion.

Kansans showed the country that a Republican controlled, midwestern state can stand up to GOP extremists and protect their fundamental right to an abortion.

I know Ohio can do the same, _but it starts right here, right now._

| | | **_Learn More About Chuck_**

---
---
| | | Family, hard work and community. These are the things that have defined me as a person more than anything else and are the things that make New Hampshire a special place. Several local Salem community leaders became role models and mentors and got me involved with helping our community. With their encouragement, I ran for Salem Selectman and won. I ran for Town Moderator and won. Then I ran for State Representative and served for two terms from 1998-2002. I was elected to the State Senate in 2002 and was appointed to the Finance Committee. My experience running a business, meeting a payroll, and keeping a conservative budget helped prepare me for the challenges of crafting a balanced state budget. I quickly became known as one of the state’s leaders in budgeting and tax policy. I took a step back from politics in 2006. My daughter was starting her junior year in high school and Susan and I spent most of the next few years traveling to her field hockey and basketball games. We were her biggest fans. In 2010, I was reelected to the Senate. When I returned to the Finance Committee, I found the financial mess that the Democrats had put our state in. The state had an $800 million deficit. We quickly turned that around and put the state’s finances back on a sustainable path. For my work, colleagues gave me the greatest honor of my life — electing me the Senate President in 2013. In 2020, I led Republican efforts to retake the majority in the State Senate. New Hampshire was the only state in the country that was able to flip a blue state legislature to red and it was largely due to our strong fight against the Democrats’ proposed state income tax. Last year, we passed one of the most conservative and fiscally responsible budgets that New Hampshire has ever seen. It is balanced, cuts taxes for small businesses, provides more than $300 million in property tax relief, bans late-term abortions, and prohibits the use of discriminatory teaching in our schools. It puts New Hampshire on a path to long-term prosperity. The work ethic, commitment to family and sense of community that I learned at a young age have stuck with me as an adult and drive everything I do. I still wake up at 4am every morning to work at our business before going to Concord to do the people’s business. More often than not, I still take my first phone calls of the day while driving a tractor. Washington, D.C. has enough silver-spoon, Ivy League lawyers. I believe that I am a product of all the best parts of New Hampshire — the spirit of freedom, sense of volunteerism and responsibility of giving back to the community that has helped shape me into the person I am today. I want to bring New Hampshire to Washington and makes sure our voices are heard. I want to bring New Hampshire values to a place that needs them now more than ever. I want to work for you and I hope you will consider electing me to represent you in the U.S. Senate.

name: Max Steiner
subject: Trump vs. The Military.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Max Steiner for Congress 2485 Notre Dame Blvd, Ste 370 #194 Chico, CA 95928
body:
Members of the military swear an oath to the Constitution, not the President. | |
---
Friend, At this point, most of you probably know how important the military is to me. That shouldn't be too much of a surprise: I've been in the Army -- Active and Reserve -- for 17 years now. Some people see their university time as their "formative years" -- I had Iraq. The upshot is that I'm a bit more sensitive to military issues than the average American. On Monday, the big national news was the raid on Mar-a-Lago. That is big, and we'll see how that develops. However, what hit me was the news that Trump had asked his Chief of Staff why his generals could not be more like Hitler's. Trump saw Nazi generals, with their "total loyalty to Hitler," as ideal. There are two massive issues here. **Number one, this is yet another example of Trump's historical illiteracy. body:
A federal judge just ruled that Georgia's system of electing members to the PSC violates the Voting Rights Act. Chris Carr has chosen to defend this practice, which dilutes votes of Black Georgians.

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/49011637/360463891/1460579386?refcode=EM_C_220809PSC_N_JJ_FULL_6_NG_N_Logo&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDAzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmY2Q3ZjIyNC0zMjE4LWVkMTEtYmQ2ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uPvdxoB9r0VmNI-oyxJeFJNZrBZK3PNl4x23MowgfBQ=)
---
For too long, Georgia has used a method of electing members of the Public Service Commission (PSC) that dilutes the power of Black voters and blatantly violates the Voting Rights Act: despite representing individual districts, commissioners are elected in a _statewide_ vote.

The PSC's decisions impact the rates Georgians have to pay for power, gas, and telecommunications — and these decisions especially affect communities of color, whether in rural Georgia or urban centers. **It's outrageous that the voices of communities of color have been diluted for so long, but that's by design.**

Last legislative session, I sought to fix this and tried to pass a bill that would require that Public Service Commissioners be elected only by the voters in the districts they represent because I believed it violated the Voting Rights Act. This past Friday, a federal judge agreed and ruled that Georgia's method of electing public service commissioners had to go.

All Georgia leaders should have celebrated this news. But my opponent Chris Carr decided to appeal the federal judge’s decision and fight for the status quo that dilutes the voting power of Black Georgians.

**This is a clear example of how our Attorney General can affect the basic foundations of our democracy.** Carr was under no obligation to appeal this ruling, and could have allowed our state to advance with free and fair PSC elections. He decided otherwise.

[**Once again, Chris Carr has failed to stand up for Georgians' rights — so it's time to double down on our efforts to defeat him on Election Day. subject: If Kari Lake wants to bring the government down over the FBI going to Mar-a-Lago, but also wants that same government to force molested children to give birth, we don’t think she should be governor of Arizona. Katie Hobbs will do a much better job, and she needs our help to win.
body:
No insurrectionists for governor
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| | | | | Peter, **It happened at last: The FBI raided Mar-a-Lago.** _We don't know yet exactly what they were looking for but apparently they opened Donald Trump's safe_, and rumors are he was keeping some classified documents illegally removed from Washington there. I'm sure we'll know more soon about which of Trump's many likely crimes led to the raid. Predictably, the Republican Party responded with their usual unhinged performative outrage, yet even worse as Donald Trump's their cult leader. Their _capo di tutti capi_ , in mob-speak. The seditionists came out screeching for shutting down the FBI, and then the secession talk started. **Among this collection of clods, crazy Kari Lake, the GOP nominee to be Governor of the key swing state of Arizona, even stuck out among the bunch:** Kari Lake is an insurrectionist who believes 10 year old girls who are raped are baby containers, wards of the state. body:
Silicon Valley oligarchs view you as their product....| | | [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b5a4eb3fe9394160bb2aa31204b81333&_e=j4ykRUphFE52xP2ULE696T989GPiRidAX_8UQdNZB1qw79Nv7nWczNyNzTfbcCsnAKfztbBnvWZgEPprCZPg9NHyk6BsddQF_HB3urOMuNUj9yBl5sKgqtkCyOrgwsZm6gZw9idw85_cx5Lh2nacTmlYJZ8Hdf8R7xpapHOfG_p9y7AObVrHBo_9uurMOnhe5qMtFYxrSzxOzYJDehJdHPiG9w-yns3nroASZx0pzM41dSoAC2L257EGB2kwsj8flfss_MD_8WzBMcMp9jitCq-5Zg0DKfmiS9fPfuMjIuon-FM5xqQpEt8166qFydinXv7m25UMh9Ohx5Bx1Z8r2zXgKOmdwRVebyuz5C7Uz6X5-x_srrsVuhGeTH1SXx_g0VjuD9M9w0_RwePWb774QooFFmlnGwjqswnmpctYocI%3D)
---
Peter, The saying goes, if you're not paying for the product, you are the product.

Today, in Silicon Valley there is a group of tech oligarchs who view _you_ as _their_ product.__
---
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b5a4eb3fe9394160bb2aa31204b81333&_e=j4ykRUphFE52xP2ULE696T989GPiRidAX_8UQdNZB1qw79Nv7nWczNyNzTfbcCsnAKfztbBnvWZgEPprCZPg9NHyk6BsddQF_HB3urOMuNUj9yBl5sKgqtkCyOrgwsZm6gZw9idw85_cx5Lh2nacTmlYJZ8Hdf8R7xpapHOfG_p9y7AObVrHBo_9uurMOnhe5qMtFYxrSzxOzYJDehJdHDUvr93q_85LsnJV01iQEVnVY90Hx8wJ4G_iTosooBwDnUWxEP-UBtsy75Q4KPYXJM2w3aVdbDBM5N3nrOHMDnT7VagZ3FWtYrjwnhIEaZkL_FtE5EKIuKjbH_dFTIbndhZLPavo82Y1TZURkHa6dPS2DxFux0rU4ZavVLXD8Ru7YI9hoDgoYTi-D7-g_Ktdwtp1_S5LRdoX4DU1ewK15og%3D)
---
**Your habits.****Your location.****Your purchases.****Your data.****Your attention.** Those are the SKUs that make up the economy of _YOU_. And they are happy to buy and sell every part of your life they can find a way to monetize. All the while they pretend they are the heroes because they gave the user something “free.”

I learned a long time ago, and I’m betting you did too, that there is no such thing as a “free” lunch. That’s clearly true when it comes to the attention merchants spewing forth from Silicon Valley.

For every email platform they give away, for the brand new smart device they subsidize your purchase of, for every new subscription service they offer what they are really doing is finding another way to get a little bit more of you, your friends, and your family into their inventory. **I am fighting for the people of Florida, not the Big Tech oligarchs in San Fransisco.** **[We the People have the power to fight back. We can fight back from the states and we can fight back from our homes.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b5a4eb3fe9394160bb2aa31204b81333&_e=j4ykRUphFE52xP2ULE696T989GPiRidAX_8UQdNZB1qw79Nv7nWczNyNzTfbcCsnAKfztbBnvWZgEPprCZPg9NHyk6BsddQF_HB3urOMuNUj9yBl5sKgqtkCyOrgwsZm6gZw9idw85_cx5Lh2nacTmlYJZ8Hdf8R7xpapHOfG_p9y7AObVrHBo_9uurMOnhe5qMtFYxrSzxOzYJDehJdHBNoZvJpkEA5PPmVNJJMOh6Vuj1t4VGjNVHj22OSxVYSs9TCZlqdL4sWJ97ngEN1EfFjB43tqfirW03HlF2asVrCvXQTVFRFusl56Q3mEL0w6erWjeSWIxFGAYpLNQUoI9guv7oJpWecL5ZaLu-dg6_MqjZVB0vZ8Gy435QESPvyTP47llUTlAwGorV-wgPDGTpMkCOlrswP8ni-KC8B4MU%3D)**__
---
It's no secret Big Tech is the unofficial censorship arm of the Democrat Machine--silencing any points of view that challenge their woke agenda and ideologies. In Florida, we stood up to Big Tech and let them know Floridians would not be victims of their blatant and biased censorship of conservative voices. **I signed into law legislation that holds Big Tech accountable by driving transparency and safeguarding Floridians ability to access and participate in online platforms without discrimination from the Leftist platforms.**__
---
**[We can fight back.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b5a4eb3fe9394160bb2aa31204b81333&_e=j4ykRUphFE52xP2ULE696T989GPiRidAX_8UQdNZB1qw79Nv7nWczNyNzTfbcCsnAKfztbBnvWZgEPprCZPg9NHyk6BsddQF_HB3urOMuNUj9yBl5sKgqtkCyOrgwsZm6gZw9idw85_cx5Lh2nacTmlYJZ8Hdf8R7xpapHOfG_p9y7AObVrHBo_9uurMOnhe5qMtFYxrSzxOzYJDehJdHGLYmcqOPTWfO5cEIXvewPMne4jaPyVKWfSfBBEgqZHJ-rrEku-2WnR1ODyqjE8VnGwQ3lmpHsqTzrNQcWodSKBNLvE8T3oS_4mttGrpSXuML9lDoHu8JZiTAzipoQQG76S48Y9jpqznn6kXjKWpn1R0RPZY7X5kFya_Kjq7lbMe4P-0P7Bpd29_HLl9X7FtWGPxlipmzvQ9LVh180gA4Ro%3D)** And we must. Because the way that big tech has managed to protect it its business from the woke mob is by playing enforcer in the liberal narrative.

Even if their monetization of our attention wasn’t harmful and dangerous (_it is_). Even if they weren't being opaque about how they use consumer information (_they are_). Even if they were good stewards of the data they’re collecting (_they aren't_)...

There would still be the simple truth that they perpetuate an overriding liberal ideology and they work day and night to silence conservative voices.

Many of these companies claimed that their initial goal was to be open and inclusive. They even highlighted that as a core advantage over the legacy media. But the reality simply doesn't match the rhetoric.

If you disagree with the woke party line:
* _Plan to be shadow banned._
* _Plan to be de-platformed._
* _Plan to be erased from the public conversation._

Right now, you're reading this email on one of their platforms. The real question is, if I were not already Governor of Florida, would they even let you read it?

That question is being asked and answered millions of times a day by faceless tech giants who have no accountability to you or any of their other customers. They can censor with impunity. And they do.

The RNC for example has shown that every time an important fundraising deadline approaches one email platform diverts their messages away from the user and into the spam box.

**Big tech believes it decides what you should read. It decides who should be able to talk to you. It decides what you should think.**
This situation is untenable. The interests of big tech are not aligned with our citizens any more. This cannot stand. **[I am standing up and I have no intention of backing down.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b5a4eb3fe9394160bb2aa31204b81333&_e=j4ykRUphFE52xP2ULE696T989GPiRidAX_8UQdNZB1qw79Nv7nWczNyNzTfbcCsnAKfztbBnvWZgEPprCZPg9NHyk6BsddQF_HB3urOMuNUj9yBl5sKgqtkCyOrgwsZm6gZw9idw85_cx5Lh2nacTmlYJZ8Hdf8R7xpapHOfG_p9y7AObVrHBo_9uurMOnhe5qMtFYxrSzxOzYJDehJdHKpsXKHTyV8_cjRlDxr3xmSiGwGD3cYV3O764qC793kopxVjP3FmCRmG7FG2T9BrEOzlmQbDALBThrfPGdC6sSFP379ULeumbt0G2zBGe5ddsnIQaOVri542u6eZBchKBx83bSY7RHYyWW-4ggt54zyAY3irHhPce2N8Wcdd8L1x1S51NXtjCgYSEqVt3da1vkTO_yaEkqERZ2eISJL_sCM%3D)**
Big tech has already come for me. I have no doubts that they will come again. I want you to be in this fight with me. **[Make a donation today, show Big Tech that you will stand up against censorship. Show Big Tech that your beliefs will not corrupted. Show Big Tech that conservatives cannot and will not be silenced in America.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=b5a4eb3fe9394160bb2aa31204b81333&_e=j4ykRUphFE52xP2ULE696T989GPiRidAX_8UQdNZB1qw79Nv7nWczNyNzTfbcCsnAKfztbBnvWZgEPprCZPg9NHyk6BsddQF_HB3urOMuNUj9yBl5sKgqtkCyOrgwsZm6gZw9idw85_cx5Lh2nacTmlYJZ8Hdf8R7xpapHOfG_p9y7AObVrHBo_9uurMOnhe5qMtFYxrSzxOzYJDehJdHOp6mnKYC8xNxlqjz0NvbEISN73Tfr15bogip-KBi-oGkkHgcBcLxS5qh2f8C5ZcEckuuTXU70Z6PF-QP_l9NYAGYsbOqKhgJ6rcvN3_ipogLmju9_HFCbpj91mL39JRVqfUDeCRddIlkijU21LrI2wOF0lEUnLclWtDdjD9KMrqpZ-ymEzK40gRODy9UGpsDCtRhrniWtvP73O9n_i7zY4%3D)** I am ready to fight them in Florida. I need your help to do it.__
---

body:
Let’s do this

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=782%2E61531%2ESG2LSo)
We did it. It’s an honor to have your support and to earn your votes, and now—thanks to your hard work—I’m the nominee for U.S. Senate.
I was just a kid when I dropped out of college and hitchhiked to Chicago to organize against housing discrimination. That choice set me on a path to public service and led me to this moment. Every victory since then, including tonight’s, wouldn’t have been possible without the support of passionate Vermonters, fighting for their neighbors from every corner of the state.
But the general election will be a much bigger challenge. With a 50-50 Senate, the GOP will flip the Senate red if they win this seat. Mitch McConnell's PAC has more than $100 million in the bank, and national Republicans have already said they want to target this “sleeper” race.
[**So I need your help. Will you pitch in a donation today and become a founding donor of our general election campaign?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3812?t=3&akid=782%2E61531%2ESG2LSo)
_If you’ve saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_

There’s so much at stake in this election: lower prescription drug costs, a Green New Deal, reproductive rights. All of those possibilities go away if we lose this seat and Mitch McConnell becomes majority leader again.
[**We can’t let that happen. So I ask you, will you become a founding donor of our general election campaign by making a donation today?**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3812?t=7&akid=782%2E61531%2ESG2LSo)
Let’s do this,
Peter

| August 9, 2022

# STATEMENT REGARDING UNPRECEDENTED RAID OF FORMER PRESIDENT’S HOME

[](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=01fbd51f29&e=ddc57b5ede)
[Read the thread on Twitter >>](https://nancymace.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f826f615915b06bdee33acac8&id=8a91e738d6&e=ddc57b5ede)
Last night we saw an unprecedented raid on the home of a former president.

What raids did we see when then Secretary of State Hillary Clinton hid a server loaded with classified documents in her bathroom? Or when Sandy Berger stole classified documents from the National Archives on multiple occasions (down his pants)?
Abuse, and in this particular instance, politically-driven abuse, happens when we allow government to take too much power and too much freedom away from its citizens. It is a symptom of a larger disease: an out-of-control federal government and its agencies doing whatever the hell they want regardless of the legality, precedent or accepted protocols.
We see abuses of civil liberties (the Patriot Act) and unconstitutional, dishonest, and biased use of the FISA court against Americans. We see it in the war on drugs and mass incarceration.
And this Friday, the far left will win its push for 87,000 more IRS agents. What will those in unprecedented positions of power do to us then?
This isn’t a left or right issue. We should all care about abuses of government power and speak up when we see them.
This is why Congress’ authority to evaluate and report on the Executive branch is so important. It’s why the Oversight Committee must have the will as well as the ability to subpoena federal agencies and hold those in contempt when they don’t show up. As a member of Oversight, I cannot emphasize this enough: we have a lot of work to do.
November can’t come fast enough! ###
